itsalihelikehsti ale utsathanvhi ohstv itsatanhthehsti v utsathihyeno etsakuyv'eti kalvlati i nahskiyayhenho utsi nitunhvnelvki anatolehohski ikvyi tsiniketsenv'elv.
nihi ama elohi utselika; iyuhskini ama yutsihskolhv kato yikalhstohta ama yatolhvna; htla nhahakwo kohuhsti khtoti yi'kaki, atinvtikwo uwahsv, ale yvwikwo unalahstati.
nihi ika itsathihstihski elohi. katuhv uhsahilhv tsikakhaho'i vlha yeli yvkayekvhskalhvka.
vlha ale yvwi anitsvhsthvka atsvhstohti alhilohsti yanulhvtihsko'i, kakhtiyhskini anikhahvhsko'ihv ikanho unathihstaneho nikatv kalhtsote aniya'i.
ika itsathihstihskv tunilvhsatatehehsti yvwi, nahskino' ohstv tetsilvwhihstanehv anikowhahthihskehstioi ale anilvkwohtihskest itsitota kalvlati' ehi.
lhe'hsti tikhanhahwatvhsti ale anatolehohski tuyohsthanilhv yihskiyelihsehehsti; vlhahskini yitakiyohsthanilhv, takikhalililhvhskini.
utohiyuhiyahyeno hi'a nitsvwehsehahi khvnhi kalvlo'i ale elohi anilohsonhvha sakwo uhsti aleh sakwo wuhstikv tikhanhahwtvhsti vlha yvkalohi kvnhi nikatiyu akhalitsvha.

nahski iyuhsti khilo ayohstihskehsti hsakwo hi'a uhstikhani ulhinetsv'i, ale nahski nuhstesti yvwi tekeyhohvhskehsti, nahski uhstikhani akohsehehsti kalvlati ehi hukvwiyuhi' kehsv'i a khihlohskini takhanhahwatekehsti, ale nahski nuhstehsti tateyohvhskehsti, kalvkwtiyu akohsehehsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i.
hiayhehno nitsvwehseha, itsvnho nahski itsatanhthi kehsv nititsikonatthanvna ikehsehsti tinowhelihski ale anikwalihsi, vlha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhiyukehsv' yvketsiyvha.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i; tlehsti tsatalhvki i ale khilo' atahihehsti kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tinukhtihskiyi.

ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehsehahv khilo tinatanhvlhi ahskakehsti kohuhsti nuhstvtihskvna ikehsehsti, kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tinuktihskiyi i khilonho tinatanhvlhi nitsatanhthvna ikohsehehsti, tekalawi'v kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti; khilonho tsaneku ikohsehehsti, kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tsvhskino atsilvyi.
nahski iyuhsti iyunho atsilvkelhstiyi hiyhohihehsti tsatanhehti, nanhahnho ihanvhtatihskehsti tihstatanvlhi kohuhsti tselihsehv'i,
nanhhatsl-klsty hihiyaskehsti htsatahneti ahle htnsksti, hikvyi ostv nstnhsti tihstatahnvtli; kilahno hilkhsti hahlisklvthskehsti tsatahnehti v tsa-da-ne-di.
nulakwo ohstv nihstv tsahyi'litohi v ahsikwo ihsta'ihsv'i, tikukhtihskiyinahsi wiyitsakhahvka tsahyi'litohi, tikukhtihskinho titaniyihskiyi wiyitsakhahvka, ale titahstutiyi yiwetsayvhta.
utohiyuhya hi'a nikvwehseha, vlha yvtvkahinuko'i, khvnhi ulihskwalhti ayelhiiyatanhthehti hhkuyvhvha.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i; lhehsti tsatayhonelvki.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehsehahv khilo akeyhv takhanihskehsti tsunanhsihtiyi utulihskehstivv kayula utayhonelvhi kehsehsti tsutanhthv'i.

iyuno hikhtholi hikhthihsi tetsotehstihskehsti, hataktheto'ihskehstiyv ale tsatekehstihi ohsiyuyhenho itsalhstanehti hsakwokwo tsalikvhalvtv yitsayohuhseha, anho unhohstv hiyelv tsvhskino wiyetsata'ineha.
iyunho tsoyeni hikhthihsi tetsotehstihskehsti s hihskwalihskehsti, ale tsatekehstihv ohsiyuyheno itsalhstanehti hsakwokwo tsalikvhalvtv yitsayohuhseha, anho unhohstv hyelv tsvhskino wiyetsata'ineha.
hi'a ikawetv iki; khihlo utali'i ikakhahvhskehsti, kanvnehehsti kowheli nahski tunakalenvhv'i.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehsehhahv khilo utali ikakhahvhskehsti, tsunhihsinhvhihskninon ikehsehsti, utayhonehtiyikwo nikvnhihsanehehsti i khilono' atsikhanhvhi atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti.
ale itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i; lhehsti tsayohsthanv tsahselithanv'i, yihowahskini niyatvnehehsti nuhstv tshahnetsv'i.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha; lhehsti yitsselithanehsti yitsane'ihsthane'hsti kohuhsti, lhehsti kalvlati yitsane'ihsthanehsti v unelanvhiyenho uwehtiyi nahski;
tlehsti ale elohi, tsulahsihtiyyenho nahski v ale tsiluhsilimi, nahskiyeno atsilvkwoti ukvwiyuhi utseli katuhv'i;
tlehst al hihskoli yitsane'ihsthanehsti, tlayhenho yeli hsakwo kilhv unekv ale kvnhahke yinvkahvka.
itsinekvhskini hi'a nuhstehsti, vv, vv; vlha, vlha; utliyhenho tsinika'o uyokwo kehsv' titalehnihsko'i.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a ikawetv kesv'i, ahkhahtha akhthakwo takvwalhvhskehsti, khayuhkanho khayuhkakwo takwalhvhskehsti.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsawehseha; lhehsti yitsatlekehsti uhsonhv netsvnelv'ihi khilohskini' hikathihsi tsakkweluhvhskehsti, so'i nahskwo hiyalihskolvtanehehsti.
khilonho utulihskehsti tsahyilitahstiyi, ale tsanaehtiyi hawini tsanhuwo, uthvnohi nahskwo hinvnehehsti.
khilohn sulhilotv ihstenvhstiyi nitsvnhehehstiav tha'li iyulhilotv ihstekehsti.
tsathayohsehi hinehehsti, tsatholvehtiyino utulihski lhehsti iyvtv ihiyatvnhelvki.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi ikawetv kehsv'i; hikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala, hihskakehstino tsahskaki.

ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha; tetsikeyuhsehsti ketsihskaki v ohstv tetsinetsehehsti ketsihskinvtihski, ohstv nitetsatvnhehehsti ketsinikwathihi, ale ohstv iyunalhstanhehtiyi itsatatolihstihskehsti kayhkoki ketsinohehski ale uyo iketsvnehi.
nahskino kalvlati ehi itsitota tsuwetsi nitsalhstihskehstiyv nahskiyhenho utseli' nvto tekananukowhihseho uniyo ale anohstv, ale takanvhtaneho unatanhthi ale uninekutsitv.
iyuynho yititsikeyuha ketsikeyuhi v kato yetsakuyvhtahshi? tlahsko nahski' yinanatvneho ayelhi-atelv anikihsitohi?
iyu ale itsatanhvlhikwo unvhsv yititsiyoliha i kato itsatvnehv tetsikonahtti anihso'i? tlahsko nahski yinanatvneho ayelhi-atelv anikihsitohi?
nihihskini' nitsihskanhvna kehsehsti nahskiya itsitota kalvlati ehi nahskanhvna tsiki.
lhehsti tsitsatalhawhihseli nahskino nihi lhehsti etsilawhihselki.
nahskiyeno nuhstv itsatalhawhihselv ahse nahskwo tetsilawhihselihvi ale nuhstv itsatalhilosvlv nahskwo tv'etsalhilo'eli.
ale katonho ihikowahthihsko utlvtalvtv ukhsuhv'i tihstatanhvlhi, nelihskvnano ikehso unhohstv ata tsvhsv tsakhsuhv'i.
ale kato yikalhstohta hi'a yiniwehsi tihstatanhvlhi i kvlvhsi utlvtalvtv tsakhsuhv'i, kvhnhiyukwonho unhohstv ata tsvhsv tsakhsuha.
tsatlonahsti! ikvyi hilv unhohst at tsvsv tsakhsuhv'i, nhahkwonho khvnhikehsvhiyu tsakowhahthvhtiyi kehsehsti hilvehtiyi utlvtalvtv tihstatanhvlhi ukhsuhv'i.
lhehsti kohuhsti kalvkwti kilhi titsinhelvki, lhehsti ale takvna-iyunahsti titsatselikah sikwa wititsatinelvki, yitanalahsta'vlikwohyenho, ale yanakhthahvna yvketsitakalv'vka.
itsithayoha, ahse tayetsineli v itsiyohka, ahse tatsiwhahthvhi; itsvnhka, ahse taytsihstu'i'eli.
khilohyenho tsathayohiho atsineho'i v khilonho tsuyhoho awhahthihsko'i, khilonho tsiwikvnhiho atsihstu'i'eho'i.
kakokhe ahskaya hi'a tsinitsatvnhv i iyunho uwetsi katu yuthayohseha, nvyakwoh yahvhsi?
ale atsati yathayohihahv tsiko inatvkwo yvkanv'vhsi?
iyunho nihi itsiyo'i yitsihsinahi ohstv kehsv titsinehtiyi titsetsiav utlihiyu utohiyuhiya itsitota kalvlati ehi ohstv tanhehehsti kvwathayohsehi.
nahski iyuhsti nika'v kohuhsti itsatulihskv yvwi iketsatvnhehtiy, nahskiya nahskwo nitetsatvnhehehsti; nahskihyenho hi'a nuhsti tikhanhahwtvhsti ale antolehohski
ayahtholhi kalohihstiyi itsiyvhsta ayhahtheniyhenho kalohihstiyi ale ayhahtheni nvnohi ayohuhihstiyi' wikananukokv'i, uni tsahthanho nnhhanlhska. a-ni-lo-s-ga.
ayhahtholhiyuhyeno kalohihstiyi ale ayhahtholhiyu nvnohi kvnhitv wikananukokv'i, ale anikayolhiyu aniwhahthiha.
tetseyhahthotsehehsti unatlonahsti anatolehohskiav awhi uninotena kaneka tsunanhuwa'i tsiketsiluhtseho'i; ahsenho hawini kehsv wayha unikhv'vhski kehso'i.
nuhstv anatathvhskv'i totatsolhihsthanihi tsiko yvwi thelvlati tanatehsko tsihstunikihstihi? ale hsvkhtha-iyunahsti' tsikotsitsihi tanatehsko'i?
nahskihskini nuhsti nika'v ohstv tluhkv ohstv atathvhsko'i, uyonho tluhkv uyo atathvhsko'i.
ohstv tluhkv' vlha yeli uyo yvkvtathvka v ale uyo tluhkv' vlha yeli ohstv yvkvtathvka.
nika'vhskini tetluhkv ohstv nanatatvhskvna, tikaleyvhstohti kehsehsti, ale atsilvhyi witatinvti.
nahski' iyuhsti totatsolhihsthani' nuhstv anatathvhskv'i.
vtlayhenho nani'v, tsakvwiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhi, kvkwohsehi, kalvlati' ehi' ukvwiyuhi kesv wuninanuko'ihsti yiki, nahskihskini na etota kalvlati' ehi atanvhthehskv tsunilvwhihstanehi.

nahiyu ika kehsehsti unitsathihsti hi'a nvtakvkiwehali; tsakvwiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhi, tlahsko tetsato'v yotstihske yotsatolehohske'i v ale lhahsko tetsato'v yotstihske anihskina yitotsinukowhihske'i v ale lhahsko tetsato'v yotstihske utsathi uhskwanikohti yitokilvwhihstanehe'i?
nhahkwonho hi'a nvtakatsiwehseli; vlha ilvhiyu yitsvkathahe'i; utli witsilohi uyo titsilvwhihstanehi.
nahski iyuhsti nani'v khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anatvkihskehsti, ale nahski nanatvnehehsti i akhthanhahi ahskaya totakatsiyatlilohsthani, nahski nvyohi tsunhehskehe'i;
nhahkwonho tsukanhahne'i, ale tsitunohukane'ihi ale tsunolvne'i, nanhhaatanhlv tstuyiloli; aseno' vhtla yuytsi, nvtsihiyeno hkakhahi. ga-ka-he-i.
nani'vnho khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anathvkihskehstiai nahskino nanatvnehvna ikehsehstihi uneku ahskaya tikekatlilohstohti kehsehsti nahski noyuhi tsunhehskehe'i.
nhahkwonho tsukanhahne'i, ale' tsitunohukane'iai ale tsunolvne'ivi nanhhatnl tstuyiloli, alhe' tsyotsi, ale' usksety tsnuhlsthane uyothsvne u-yo-tsv.
hiano nulhsthane'i v nahski tsihsa uhskwatv nahski nikawehskv'i, unihskwanikose' tateyhohvhskv'i.
utselikayenho tsitateyhvhsko iyuhsti kehse'i, vlhanho tinowhelihskikwo tsitanateyhohvhsko iyuhsti yikehse'i.
nhahkwono tsukhso'ahsv uhsahilhv'i, hunitsathi kvwhstawatvhse'i.
ale kvnhiyukwo atayhehski utlvki uluhtse utatolihstanele'i, hi'a nuwehse'i; tsakvwiyuhiah iyunho yitsatanhthelv yelikwo yihskinvkalv.
tsihsanho utoyanvhitv uhsvnhile'i, katanvthvli, tsatanvkalvtv kehsehsti, uwohsele'i; khilakwonho iyvtv atayhehski utlvkv utanvkalvhe'i.
hi'anho tsihsa nuwehsele'i; kha tlehsti khilo tsihinonheli, henakwohskini, witsakowhahtv atsilv akelhohi, ale alhskolhtohti whihvka mohs unhetsv alhskohltoti nahski unatolehohihstohtiyi
nhahkwono tsihsa kekwani wi'uluhtsv, uluhtshele ahskohikkwi aniyahwski tithinhitohi, uhstiyethane'i,
hi'a nuwehsele'i; tsakvwiyuhi, tsinvhsitahsti kanhka tikwenvsv utlvka ulvtalv'vhska utsathanvhi akilhiyoka.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i; takehsi tatsinvwanehsi.
ahskohitskwinho tithinhitohi ti'unhetsv hi'a nuwehse'i; tsakvwiyuhi, lhayeli yiniko'i tsinelv tsayvhstiyi; hinhekikwohskini uwahsv, tsinvhsitahstinho tayutiwhsi.

ayvyhenho tikwatanelhtikwo v ale takikhah aniyahwski nahski tekvkwanelhto'i, khilonho hena tsiyohsi, eko'i; nvwatalenho ehena tsiyohsi, ti'eko'iav tsinvhsitahstino, hi'a nhhatvka tsiyohsi, nahski natvneho'i.
tsihsanho uthvkanv uhskwanikohse'i i ale hi'a nituwehsele nvtakvwahstawatvtv, utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha, vlha nahskwo ihsili tuto'v nahski ika'i kohihyti kehsv yakiwahthvhv.
ale hi'a nitsvwehseha; unitsathi tikhalvkv ale wutelikv ititlv tinilohskehsti, ale itsulaha ananv'vhskehsti ekwahami, ale ehsiki, ale tsekkwi, kalvlati ehi nanhhkvwyh kesvhi, ge-sv-i,
kalvlatihskini ehi nanhhukwyh keeyhanehi taktsnukwhsi witotakekatahsi tsulisikv toytihtlv, nnhhtaniyvksti, ale tanilvtkhskehsti tanntki. da-ni-lv-da-gi-s-ge-s-di da-ni-nu-do-gv-i.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele ahskohitskwi tithinhitohiyv henahv ale nuhstv tsohiyunhv nahski winitsalhstahsi i unvhsitahstino nahiyukwo utiwhse'i.
tsihsano kwita kanelv uluhtsv, ukohe kwita utali'i utsi'vhkanvhke utilhehvhske'i.
uhsvnhilenho uwoyeni, utilhehvhskvnho utiwhha'i. tulenhenho ale tuhstelvhitole'i.
uhsvnho nulhsthanv, unitsathe anihskina tikvwaniya'i tekvwahthinhohele'i; tunukowhihsenho anihskina khanekvkwo khtihske'i, ale nikatv tsunitlvki tunhvwane'i.
utohiyuhtiyi ayelvhsvki' ihsay atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'ihi uwahsv ikikihstanelvki titiwanakalahiyu kehsv'i, tekitlvkvnho tsutseli nituwanelvki.
tsihsanho tukohv unitsathi yvwi kvwatlatwihstihskv'i, unhetse' ihskonv wunilohihstiyi.
khilonho iyuhsti tikowhelihski uluhtse'i, hia nuwehsele'i; thateyhohvhski takvhstawatitoli nika'v hetohv'i.
tsihsanho hia nuwehsele'i; tsulha tunithalehso'i, tsihskwanho kalvlo' anehi tunanhehstalhaho'i i yvwihskini uwetsi' vlha ilvhtlv ahskholi uhtiy yiki.
nvwatalenho uhstawatitoh hi'a nuwehsele'i; tsakvwiyuhi, ikvyi kena tsinihsanhuka etota.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehale'i; skihstawatukaav unanelkinho tsuniyohuhsvhi taninihsihskehsti tsunatseli tsuniyohuhsvhi.
nhahkwono tsiyuh wutsanv kvhwstawatitohi kvwahstawatvse'i.
kvnhiyukwonho utsathi uhyilolhe unole itali; tsiyuhyeno ama talhstilhanekv uwulhv'vhske'i; ahsenho ikalhihekwo.
kvhwstawatitohinho kvwaluhtshele kvwayhehsthane'i i hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; tsakvwiyuhi, skihstelv, tayotsatsvnhikwo.
hi'ano ntuwehsele'i, katonho itsihska'iha v uhsti' itsohiyuhihi nhahkwono tulenhv tushkatse unole ale vtali, utsathinho utatshinahstvhi nulhsthane'i.
anihskayanho unihskwankose'i, hi'a nuniwehse'i; kato uhsti hi'a ahskaya, nahskwoyhenho unole ale vtali ikvwohiyuhvhska.

hskontitlvnho' wuluhtsv kakisini unatselikohihi anithali anihskina tikvwaniya'i tekvwatlohse'i, tatanihsahv tsuninukotse'i v utsathanvhi' uninhahlvhiyu kese'ivi nahski' vlha khilo nanha hkvwalohihsti yikese'i.
ale khvnhiyukwo unelhunhe'i, hi'a nuniwehse'i; vlha kohuhsti' tikatatvhtohti yiki nihi, tsihsa unelanvhi uwetsi, tsiko' anhi tsa'luhtshilv skinikilhiyo'ihstohtiyikwo ahsikwo nahskwalihskvna?
kehinho iyvtv tinetohe unitsathi sunatatlki hsihkwa analhstayvnhitohe'i.
anihskinanho kvwathayohsele'i, hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; iyunho skininukowhihsvha, unnelaki hskinelihselvha sihkwa hsuntalhuhki' wikohstiyvstiyi.

hi'ano' nituwehsele'i; stena. uninukotsvno, sihkwa hsunatalhki wituniyvlhe'i v ale khvnhiyukwo nikatv sunatalhki hsihkwa ayanuliyu unalihse'i, wunikhso'ahse kanelhuhki kvhsv'ihe vtali wunalihthatinvhse'i, ale amayi tuniliwhotse'i.
tinikhthiyanho unalihse'i, tikatuhv wunilohsi, nikatv wuninhohelhe'i, ale anihskina kvwaniya'i nunalhstanhelv'i.
khvnhyukwonh nikatiyu skatuki tsuninukotse'i, tsihsa tekvwatlohsilhe'i; kvwakohnho kvwahthayohsele utanvhstiyikwo unatselikohi kehsv'i.
wituyhanvhvnho thalatu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohihv tunhelv anihskina tsuninukowhihstiyivi ale tsunatanhvwotiyi nika'v tunitlvkv v ale nika'v vyuki.
hianho nahski nuhsti tunato'v thalatu iyanitv ketsinvhsitv. ikvyiyi sawani kwita tsanohseho'i i enitinho nahskikwo unhvlhi, tsiminho tsekwiti uwetsi, tsaninho nahskikwo unhvlhi.
kwilikinho, watalamino, taminho, matunho atelv akihsitohihi tsiminho elikwi uwetsi, lekwiyano tatiya tsanohseho'i,
sawaninho akenaniti, tsutahsinho ihskalati nahski tsihsa tsulonuhelhvki.
nahski hi'a thalatu iyanitv tsisa tunvhsvki tunhetselvnho hia nituwehselvki v tsunatalenhvtv yvwi tinehv ititlv lhehsti witsilohsvki, aleh sameli anehi tunituhv lhehsti itsiyvlhvki
awhihskini unalenahitv ihsili sitanelv kehsv titsiwhahthvhuka.
itsa'ihsvno itsalihtsitohvhskehsti, hia nitsiwehskehsti; kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhiyikehsv ehskanhiyu taya'i.
tsunitlvki tetsinhvwihskehsti v atayhehski tsunitlvki tetsinvkalihskehsti, tsuniyohuhsvhi tetsaletihskehsti, anihskina tetsinukowhihskehsti v ahsekwo etsinelvhi, ahsekwo itsatanhehehsti.
lhehsti tetsatatlohv yitsatanelhehsti talonike atelv ale unekv atelv ale vtsayi,
ale tekalhti, ale thali' titsanhuwo, ale tilahsulo, ale titolanvhsti; tsulvwhihstanehihyeno uwhahthvhti kehso ulhstayvhti.
ilvhtlvnho uthvna katuhv ale uhsti katuhv itsiluhkehstiai itsatatvtvhvhskehsti khilo' ehv utanhthihi nanhahnho itsinehsti khvnhi vtsanhiki.
atanelvnho itsiyvha itsiyolihehsti.

iyunho nanhhannl uwthiyatv tikvwhahnatanilisti ikesehsti, nahski wtohytv tsahthsehli unlutseti kehsestihsehsiyuhno tikwntanlhst nikesv'na ikehsesti, naski nvwthytv ihthsvhsvkwo' itsihlutseti ikesesti. i-ge-se-s-di.
iyunho khilo nititsatanilvkvna ikehsehsti v ale itsinhekv nathvkihskvna' ikehsehsti, nanhahkalhtsot al kathv itsnuhkoki, tetsinvkvtsksti kahta ttslasten. di-tsa-la-si-de-ni.
uthyhy ha nitsvywehseha, ehskakwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti sotami ale komali, tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsehsti, utlihiyu nahski na katuhv'i.
kvnhiyukwo itsvnvli awhi uninotena tsanhelatitoho wayhohi nahskiya'i; nahski' iyuhsti inatv iketsihsinahsani kehsahsti, ale kule-tinihskonhihi iketsatanhthi kehsehsti.
tetseyhahthotsehehsti atin yvwi, tekalawi'vhyenho totaketsathinholhi, tsunilawihstiyinho totaketsili'vnhili.
ale ayv kehsv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti nunikvwiyuhsateki ale unikvwiyuhi tunolhv ikvyititlv tetsathinhohihehsti, nahski unvhsv ale tsunatalenhvtv yvwi unatolehohihstohti.
ahsenho nhahkwo teketsathinohihehsti lhehsti yitselihihskehsti iyuhsti itsine'ihstiyi ale itsiwehstiyi; nahiyukwohyeno etsinehti kehsehsti itsiwehstiyi.
vtlayhenho nihi yitsinheko'i, itsitotahskini utanhto khaneko'i nihi' itstihsko'i.
ahskayanho totayuyohsi uyohuhihstiyi tinatanhvlhi, akayvlikenho uwetsi' totayuyohsioi ale onhi tsunathvhsvhi totvnatluthani tsu'nikayvlike'i, ale nahski nvtvnvnhihsahni tiketsi'ihsti kehsehsti.
ale nani'vkwo yvwi' ketsihskaki kesehsti ayv takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti; ahsenho nahski kvlhskwatihski alhinikvnehi atsihstelvhti kehsehsti.

ale nhahkwo uyo niketsvnhahtekehsti ilvhtlv katuhv'i, ilolihskehsti nvwalile tikatuhv witsilohskehsti. utohiyuhiyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha, vlha ihsiliyi tekatuhv'i yiketsetonhehsti nhahkwo yvwi uwetsi taka'luhtsi.
titelokwahski vlha utli yinatsilvkwotho'i ehskakwo tsuweyhohvhskiai ale atsinvhsitahsti' vlha utli hyinatsilvkwoto'i svhskakwo unvhsitohi.

yelikwoyheno titelokwahski tsuweyhohvhski itsulahakwo yiki, ale atsinvhsitahsti unvhsitohi itsulahakwo yiki. iyuyhenho tsutathinhahi atanelv kwelitsikwa yunohselv, utli ahitiyu nahski itsuniwehsetiyi tutathinhahai.
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti yititsihska'ihehsti. vtlayhenho kohuhsti' yikvhskalha nahski kvnikehsv iyulhstohti nikehsvna kehsv'i, vlha ale kohuhsti utelitv yiki nahski atolehohihsti nikehsvna kehsv'i.
ulhsihkv i'tsvnetselv'i ikakathv itsi nekehsti; etsatonv'elvnho kehsv kahsanali itsalhtsitohvhskehsti.
ale lhehsti yititsihskaihehsti ayelv'i anihihi, asenho atanhto kvwahnihsti nikesvna tsiki. ukvwiyuhsehstihskini etsihska'ihehsti nahski tikvwahihsti tsiki ayelvi ale atanhto itsula tsvhskinhohi.
tlahsko anitha'li tsihskwayah sakwo iyatanhtheti tsunakvwalhti yiki, ahseno' vlha hsakwo elati unv'ihsti yiki itsitota' utanhthelhvhi nikehsvna.
nahskwohskini' itsihsthiyehkv itsihskholi nikatiyu tihselhvhi.
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti yitsihskaihehstihi utliyhenho nika'v titsakvwalhti nihi' ehskakwo unitsathi tsiskwaya.
khiloyhehno khvnhikehsv nakwvnehehsti yvwi anikhthahv'i i nahskwo ayv nahski khvnikehsv utatsiyvneli etota kalvlati ehi akhthahv'i.
khilohskini iakwatahyihehsti yvw anikhthahv'i, nahskwo ayv nahski tatsiyatayili etota kalvlati ehi akhthahv'i.
lhehsti thohiyi unanukowihsilhv elohi, yihskiyelihsehehsti i vtlahskini thohiyi yakinanukowhihsilhv, ayelhstihskini kanvhitv.
ayvyhenho aki'luhtsilhv, tinatahskaki iyulhstohtiyi ahskaya utotanho, ale akanvki akeyhv utsihnovi ale utatsohiya utsohinho;
khilonho uwahsvkwo tutathinhahv kvwahskaki kehsehsti.

khilon utli nukeyuhsehsti utota ale utsi ehskakwo ayv nakikeyuhsehstiav vtla yeli nahski' ayv akwatseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti. khilono utli nukeyuhsehsti uwetsi ahskaya ale uwetsi akeyhv ehskakwo ayv nakikeyuhsehsti a vlha yeli nahski' ayv akwatseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti.
khilo nayihskvna ikesehsti utseli tsutanhahawatv ale nakhstawatekvna ikehsehsti, vlha yeli ayv akwatseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti.
khilonho kvnhv iawhahthihskehsti, nahski uyohuhsehti kehsehsti; kilono' iuyohusehehsti kvnhv ayv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, nahski uwhahthvhti kehsehsti.
khilonho tetsatanilvkehsti, nahski ayv takwatanilvkehsti; khilonho' ayv takwatanilvkehsti, nahski tatanilvkehsti nvtvkinvhsvhi

khilonho tatanilvkehsti atolehohski' atolehohski kesv utikalhstohtikehsti, atolehohski akkuyvtahnti kehsv nahski akakuyvtnehehsti; khilonho tatanilvkehsti utanhthi ahskaya utanhthi kesv tikalhstoh tihskehsti, utanhthi ahskaya akakuyvtahnti kehsv nahski akakuyvtnehehsti.

khilonho sakwo hi'a tsunhsti kesvi ulihskwitikwo akhali'i uyhvtltam ahvskst hakihstahwtith khehs ntikalistohtiskeshti, utohihyuhihya nitsvhweseha, vhtla nashki yohsti yihkehsehsti kakuhyeti kesv'ihti ge-sv-i.
hi'anho nulhsthanvki; tsihsa uhskwa'tv tekhanetsehv thalatu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi, unhikihsvki nanhahni, tuteyhohuhsvki ale ulhtsitonvhsvki tunitunhahai.
nhahkwonho tsani tsatsihstuhv tsuthvkanv nuhstv tulvwhihstanehv kalonetv, totsunvhse anitha'li kvwhstawatitohi,
hi'a nvtayuwehselvki; nihihsko na uluhihsti' tsiki, tsikokhe nvwtale otsikathenohehsti?
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki; tsihstena tsani' wi'ehstinohvhsi nika'v ihstatvkihskv'i ale ihstikowhahthihskv'i:
tinikhewi anikowahthiha, tiniyo'ulhinho anetoha, atayhehski tsunitlvki tunatiwhska, tsunili'enanho anahthvkiha, tsuniyohuhsvhino tekekaletiha uyonho iyunatvnhahteki ohstv khanohetv ikekalitsitonheha.
ale ohsiyu iyulhstanhehti khilonititsiyotehstihskvna ikehsehsti.
i'unenvnho tsihsa ulenvhvkih hi'a ntuwehselvki unitsathi tsani tunohehtanelvki; kato itsakhthanhvhse inake'i? wahsonahsko unole uthelvhehskv'i?
katokhe itsakhthanhvhse'i? ahskayahsko tiwanake tsunhuwa'i? kvnhiyukwo tiwanake tsunanhuwa'i unikvwiyuhi taninelv aneho'i.
katokhe' itsakhthanhvhse'i? atolehohskihsko? v'v, itsvyohseha, ale utlihiyu ehskakwo atolehohski.
nahskihskini hi'a' na kekowhelv hia hatsinohehlskv tsinikvnhv; kvnhiyukwo, tsinvli tsinvhsitahsti tsakhathv ikvyititlv, nahski tatsatvnv'ihstaneli tsalohihstiyi ikvyititlv.

utohiyuhya hi nitsvwehseha, anikeyhv kvwninnukowhihsvhi tsiki vlha khilo yunanukotsv kvwtalinehitehti tsani titawohski; ahseno uhstikhani kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo tsani'.
tsaninho titawohski unanukotsv nvtakvwatalenvtv khohi iyahsthi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ananeluki'eha, ananelukihskinho kvhskahstaki taniniyiha.
nani'vyhenho anatolehohski ale tikhanhahwatvhsti anatolehohskvki tsani unanukotsilv iyahsthi.
iyunho tiketsatanilv'ihsti kehsehsti, nhski hi'a ilaya uluhihsti' tsikehsvki.
khilo tekaliluhkehsti uthvkotiyi nahsk athvkihskehsti.
katokhe totakatsiyatlilohsthani hiha khohi tsaneha? tiniyolhikwo nahskiya kanhtohtiyi tsanino'i ale tsiwitaniyanihsko unetahstiyi
ale hi'a tsinitaniwehseho'i; atselhuhki' okhthanv tetsvnoki'elv, ahsenho' vlha yitsalihskisvhi totsiyvhkvki itsathvkoti, ahsenho vlha yititsatloyhilv.
tsaniyhenho uluhtsvki vlha yalhstayvhvhske'i ale vlha yatithahske'i, ahsenho nianiweha v ahskina uya.

yvwi uwetsi uluhtsv alhstayvhvhska ale atithahskahv hi'anho ni'aniweha; kvniyukwo ahskaya ukhv'vhski alhstayvhti ale kikake-atithahsti a atelv anikihsitohi ale anihstena unali'i. ahsenho akhthanhahi tsuwetsi ohsiyu ikvwayelvha.
nhahkwonho ulenvhvki tukvhskolvnvki tunituhv'i nnhhutl iki uskwni'koti tulhwstaneli, ntakalihstotiskvki tunatahnvhtv ntninetlihyhsvn ni-du-ni-ne-tli-yv-sv-na ge-sv-i.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti kolehsini i uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti kwetsayitisi iyuyhenho uhskwanikhti htekalvwhihstanelv nihi' itsehv yitokalvwhihstanele thaya ale satoni v kohiki tikvwaninetliyvtv yikehse tunatanhthv'i v tsuhsihthena yitunanhuwo'e ale kohstu yunatanvliye'e'i.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha; ehskakwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kesehsti thaya ale hsatoni, tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsehsti, utlihiyu nihi.
nihino kekwani kalvlati iyvtv tsetsahsalata, tsvhskinhohi wvtayelo'vhthani; iyuhyenho uhskwanikti tekalvwhihstanelv nihi' itsehv yitokalvwhihstanele sotamiyi v ahsi khohi kehsv yinikvwhstekwo.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha; ehskakwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti hsolimi tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsehsti v utlihiyu nihi.
nahiyu tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nuwehsvki; kvyali'elitseha etota, htsakvwiyuhi kalvlati ale elohi, nahski hiha tsihtehvhskalanelv anihsinahsani ale aneyhahthahi, tiniyolhinho tsitehinanukowhihselv.
vhv, etota, naskiyhenho ohsiyu tsayelvnhvhi.
nika'v kohuhsti takiyohihselv etota, ale' vtla khilo yakhthaha uwetsi utotakwo uwahsv a vlha ale khilo yakhthaha akayvlike'i uwetsi uwahsv, kilono nahski tsinanukowhihsi ela uwetsi.
etsena, ayvh skiluhtsi i nikatiyu akilhiya titsilvwhihstanehi, ale kaketv titsalihsehi v ayvnho tatsvyawehsolvhsthani.
itsiyv akwakilhanalo aleihskiyatelhohkwahsi, akwatanhthiyuyheno ale akwatatolihstiyu akinawiyi, tatsiwhahthvhino titsatanhto tsuyawehsolvhstiyi.
akwakilhanaloyheno nuhihsohtvna, kalihsehvnho utahsahkhahiyu.
nahiyu tsihsa a'ihsvki awhihsv utsalehsti unatotakwahskv ika; kvwahstawatitohino akonu tuniyohsihskvki, ale unalenvhvki unihskutesvki utsalhehsti ale unihstikvki.
ahsenho anikwalihsi unatolehohsv hi'a nvkvwawehselki; khvnhiyukwo ikvtvneti nikehsvna unatotakwahskv ika nanatvne ketsahstawatitohi.
ahsenho hi'a nituwehselvki; lhahsko yitsikoliye'o tewi nutvnelv akonu tsuyohsihske, ale nahski' anehi,
unelanvhi utseli atanelv tsuyvlhe'ihv ale akathohti katu tsuke'i, yeli' kvwakihsti nikehsvna tsikese'i, ale nahski anehi, atsilvhskini-anelhohi unvhsv?
lhahsko nahskwo yitsikoliye'o tikhanhahwtvhstiyi' nahski unatotakwahskv ika uthvna tikathawihstiyi atsilv-anelhohi unatotakwahskv aniyohstihskv, ale unihskanvtsvhi nikehsvna kesv'i?
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha v anhi etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo uthvna tiklawi'ihstiyi.
yitsikhtho'vhsehskini kathkv hi'a nahski tsinikaweha, atatolihsti kehsv akwatuliha, vlhanho atsilv-kelhstiyi kesv'i, vlha unihskanvtsvhi' yitoketsiyelvnhe nunihskanvtsvna.
yvwiyhno uwetsi ukvwiyuhi nhskwo unatotakwahskv ika.
nanhahn iutanvsv, tsunilawi'ihstiyi wuyvlhvki.
kvnhiyukwonho etohvki ahskaya uwoyeni uwa'ihselvhi. kvwahtvtvnhvkinho hi'a nuniwesvkiva tsiko yelikwo kvtanhvwoti unatotakwahskv'i; kvwayhi'litahstiy unatulihskvki.
hiano ntuwehselvki; tsiko ahskaya utahsuya' itsehv'i i iyunh sakwo awhi unotena yunalha'a, athalehsvnho yulvtsv unatotakwahskv'i, nahski wuniyhti ale wulehsti nikehsvna?
nika'vhskini utlihiyu atsilvkwotiyu yvwi ehskakwo awhi unotena. nahskihskini iyuhsti yelikwo ohstv tikalvwhihstahnti unatotakwahskv ika.
nhahkwonho hi'a nuweselv ahskaya; hatoyanvhita; utoyhanvhitvkinho. ale utiwhhsvki, nahskiyalhso'i nuhstv nulhsthanvki.
nhahkwonho anikwalihsi uninukotsv uninhohelv iyunvnhtiyi' unihihstiyi.
ahsenho tsihsa utolehohsv nanhhutnsk; unihtsathno kvwstwathsvhki; ale nkat tunvwanki, du-nv-wa-nv-gi,
ale tunvhstatelv khvnikehsv' ikvwanhtiyi.
utohiyuhtiyi ayelvhsvki ihsaya atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'i;
kvniyukwo tsinvhsitahsti tsiyahsuyetv tsikeyui tikwatanhtv iyvtv ohstv tsiyelv'i; tatsineli akwatanhto, ale tsunatalenhvtv yvwi tuyukhtv' tsunnukohwsehti kehsesti.
vlha tsuthiyohsti ale uwelhuhti yikehsehsti, vlha ale khilo uthvkanehti yikehsehsti khanekv tekalanvtv'i.
wahsona' uyehthawotsvhi vlha tsuskwalhsti yikehsehsti, ale tholetv tsukhsvhsti vlha uhwtlattihsti yikehsehsti, khvnhi atalinehitonhvha tuyuhktv' kesv tayelihihstihskv'i.
ale tuto'v tsunatalenhvtv yvwi analihskahstohtihskehsti.
nhahkwono akathinhohelvki' ahskina uya'i tikhewi ale uwakhewi, ale unhvwanvki; nahskino tikhewi ale uwakhewi uwonihsvki ale ukohvki.
nikatvno yvwi unihskwanikohsvkivi hi'a nuniwehsvki; tlahsko hi'a tewi uwetsi yiki'?
ahsenho anikwalihsi unathvkanv i hi'a nuniwesvki; hia' vlha anihskina yitikanukowhihska khvnhi tsuhstelihsko' kwelitsikwa ukvwiyuhi anihskin unatselika.

ale tsihsa akhthahv nuhstv anatanhthehskv'i, hi'a nituwehselvki; nika'v ayelhi kolhvhsi tha'li tsinatatihsko uwahsvkwo tsatatlutihsko ayokokwo; ale nika'v katuhv ale atanelv tha'li tsinatatihsko uwahsvkwo tsatatlutihsko vlha yinikvwahstokwo.
iyu ale hsetani setan yikanukohwihska, tha'li natatihsko'i uwahsvkwo atatlutihsko'i; katonho yikalhstohta yinikvwhstikwo utselikohi?
iyunho' ayv kweltsikwa yakhsteli ahnskina yittsinukowihska, kako unihstelihsko titsetsi tsitaninukowhihsko'i? nahskihskini tiketsukhtaneh kehsehsti.
iyuhskini ayv unelhanvhi utanhtho yikvti anihskina' yititsinukowhska, nhahkwohskini kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv' itsiluhtselv.
ale kato yatvka kl ulhinikitv ahskaya kanelv yayvha ale unhahv yawonv, iyuno' ikvyi nulhvlvna yiki nahsk ulhinikitv ahskaya? khila nhahkwo yawonv kaneli unhahai.
khilo nakwalikonhehvna, nahski akwatlutiha; khilon nohstilhihsihskvna, nahski yatikaleyahska.

nahski' iyuhsti hi'a nitsvwehseha; nika'v nutalehsv ahskanv'ihsti kesv' ale ahsotlvhtohti kesv' ketsitolihstikwo kehsehsti yvwi; kalvkwtiyuhskini atanhto ahsotlvtohti kehsv vlha ketsitolihsti yikehsehsti yvwi.

ale khilo kawonihskv atlutihskehsti yvwi uwetsi, atsitolihstikwo kehsehstihi khilohskini kawonihskv atlutihskehsti kalvkwtiyu atantho, vlha atsitolihsti yikehsehsti kohi kehshv ale nahskwoh so'iyi tikehsv'i.
lhkv ohstv nitsvka uthvnho ohstv, ale tluhkv uhsonhv nitsvka uthvnho uhsonv'i; tluhkvyheno' kolhihstohti kehso' nuhstv utv'i.
yo' inatv tsunetsi nihi! tsinitsiyo'iyv kato yikalhstohta ohstv yitsiwonihi? utsathvyeno onawhiyi' owhi vholi kawonihsko'i.
ohstv yvwi, ohstv uhskwanikotv unawiyi, ohstv kananukowhihsko'i v uyonho yvwi, uyo uhskwanikotv uyo kannkowhihsko'i.
hianho nitsvwehseha; nika'v uyo aniwonihskv yvwi, uninoheti kehsehsti tikukhthohtiyi ika kesv'i.
hinkvyhenho tsatutalehstohti kehsehsti v ale hinekv tsaskanvtsv titsatukhtaneti kehsehsti.
nhahkwonho khilo iyunahsti tinowelihsk ale anikwalihsi uninehtsv, hi'a nuniwehsvki; thateyhohvhskiav uyelhthv okatuli itsvkowhahthvehtiyi.
unhetsvno hi'a nituwehselvki; kohi tsaneha uniyo ale tinatayhonehi uyelhtv uniyhoho'i; ahsenho uyelvhtv vlha ketsinehti yikehsehsti, tsona atolehohski utselika uyelhtv uwahsv.
tsonahyenho tso'i' ika ale tso'i hsvnoyi atsa'ti' ekwa uhskwolhiyi tsaya'e'i, nahskwohskini yvwi uwetsi tso'i ika a'le tso'i hsvnoyi katohi hawin aya'ehsti.

yvwi' niniwi tsanehvki totvnalenhi takvwanatluthani kohi tsaneha, tikukhtotiyhi ika kesv'i, ale uhnskanvtsv khvnikehsv utvnvneli; nahskiyheno tunatanhthv tuninetliyvhsvki tsona alhtsitohvhskv nuwanhihsanhvki i khvnhiyukwonho ani' etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo tsona.

ukvwiyuhi' akeyhv' tsukanawv tsehe'i totvlenhi tayunatluthani kohi tsaneha tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsv'ivi ale unihskanvtsv khvnikehsv nvtakvneliav nahskiyhenho katohi wahsthv iyvtv tsuwenvhse uthvkanilhe solimnv akhthanhahiyu kehsv'i, kvniyukwonho anhi' etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu' ehskakwo hsolimonv.
iyuno kataha atanhto yvwihi kanuko'i, ukhayotvhi etoho'i uyawehsolvhstiyi uyhoho'i, ahsenho' vlha yawhahthihsko'i.
nhahkwono hi'a nikawehsko'i; titsinelv tikinukotsv yvtvtsilohsi. nhahkwono wika'luhki awhathihsko uhsiwha kehso' ale kvnohsatvhi ale kotu'ihsto'i.

nhahkwnho' i'eki witayhanihsko uwanatale kalhkwoki' anihskina utli iyuninekutshitv ehskakwo uwahsv, nanhahno aniyvhiho'i ale ananelatihsko'i, onhino nuhstv na ahskaya utli uyo'iyu kehso'i ehskakwo ikvyiyi. nahskihskini nunstehsti kohi uninekutsitv tsaneha.
ahsikwo tekawonetihskv yvwi, kvnhiyukwo utsi' ale analinvtli toyitlv anitona'vki, unatulihskvki kvwalhinohehtohtiyi.
khilonho hi'a nuwehselvkiai kvnhiyukwo tsatsi ale itsalhinvtli toyi anitona'a, ketsalinohehtohtiyi unatuliha.
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehselv unhohnelhvhi; kako etsi? ale kako otsalhinvtli?
wituhsonnho kvhwstawatitohi hi'a nuwesvki; kvnhiyukwo etsi ale otsalhinvtli.
khiloyhenho natvnehehsti nuhstv utulihskv etota kalvlati ehi, nahski vkhinvlhi ale vkito ale etsi.
nahiyu ika tsihsa unukotsvki atanelv'ivv ale vtalulhti uwenhvki.
unitsathin yvwi kvwatalhuwhihsthanvki, nahski iyuhsti tsiyuhi utsanvki v ale uwenhvki. nikatiyunho' nahski unitsathi amayulhti anitona'vki.
te'uwonhthanvhno utsathi tsutalenhvtv tulhilohstanelvki'e hi'a nuwehshvki; kvnhiyukwo, awhihski uwhihsvhse'i.
uwhihsvnho ikatv nvnohulhti hulakeyatvtse'i, tsihskwanho uniluhtse ale unuthihsonhe'i.
ikatvnho nvyohi kehsv ulakeyatvtse'ihv kayolhi kata' kalakeyv'i, khilakwonho iyvtv ulhiyenhe'i, nvtikalhstohtihske sake'iyu kehsv kata.
ahsenho nvto tsukhalvtsv uleyvhse'i, nitunhahstetlvnanho kehsv hiyuhsti unhahskvtsekwo.
ikatvnho anukalhvhi ulakeytvtse'i i anukalhvnho tsuthvhs unenulahsthane'i.
ikatvhskini ohsv katohi ulakeytvtse'ivv nahskino ukhthathane'i, ikatv ahskohitskwi unhehkwotse'i, ikatvnho hsutalahskohi unehkwotse'ihv ikatvnho tso'ahskohi unhehkwotse'i.
khilo tekaluhkehsti uthvkotiyi wahthvkvka.
kvwahstawatitohinho kvwaluhtshelv hi'a nikvwawehselvki v katonho tehiwonhtihskv tsitehalhilohstaneha?
unhetsvnho hi'a nituwehselvki; nvtikalhstohtihskini nihi etsinelvhi kehsv' itsolhihstiyi utelitv kehsv kalvlati' ehi uhkv wiyuhi kehsv'i, navhskini vlha kekalihskoltanelvhi yihki.
khilohyenho uhehsti atsinehti kehsehsti, utsathinho uhehsti; khilohskini nuhvna kehsehsti atsiki'ehtikwo kehsehsti nahskiv nahskwo' uhv'i.
nahski nvtikalhstohtiha tsitekatsiyatlilohstaneha i anikowhahthihskvyhenho vlha yinahthkiha al vthla yinholika.

ale anehv utohiyunhv ihsaya tsutolehohse'iki hi'a tsinuwehse'i; itsathvkihskv itsathvkihskehsti, ahsenho vlha yitsolhkehsti v ale itsikowhthihskv itsikowhahthihskehsti' v ahsenho vlha yitsatolehohskehsti.

hiayhenho yvwi tsuninawhi tulitsohvhsv, ale tanililuhkv kayolhiyu tathvkiha, ale tinikhtholi tunihstunhv; nahski tinikhthol tikvwanikowahthvhtohti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi, ale tanilihlkv tikvwnathvkottinikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi, ale tsuninawhi tikvwanolhihstohti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi, ale tikvwanatanetliyv'ehti nikehsvna tunatanthv a ale tikaktsinvwoti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiy.
nihihskini titsikhtholi tikalvkwthanvhi, nahskiyno takowhthiha, ale tetsilihlkv'i v nahskiyenho tathvkiha;

utohiyuhiyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha, unitsathi anatolehohski ale unatanhthi unatulvtv hutsikowahthvtiy hia nahski tsitsikowahthihavv ahsenho vlha unikohvhi yiki; ale unathvkotiyi hi'a nahski tsitsatvkiha, ahsenho' vlha unathvkanvhi yiki.
nahski iyuhsti' nihi itsathvkvka talhilohsthv awhihski.
iyuno khilo athvkvka khanohetv kalvlati ehi ukvnayuhi kehsv ukvwalhi, nikolhkvnanho tsikehso'i, nhahakwo unekutsitv ka'luhko'i ale uki'eho awhihsv unawhiyi. nahski hi'a unohulhti tsawhihse'i.
hi'anho nahski nvyohi tsawhihse'ihsi nahski tsatvkihsko khanohetv, ale khilakwo iyvtv ulihelitsvhi tsitatanilvko'i;
ahsenho nitunhahstetlvnakwo kehso'ivv ale lhekakwo tsitakhanhahwateko'i; akilhiyvyheno kananuko'i ale khanohetv tvlhiyilvhsta akateyahthohta, khilakwo iyvtv tuwotehiho'i.
hi'anho nahskwo anukalhvhi tsawhihse'i, nahski tsatvkihsko khanohetv, elohnho uwelihihsti kehsv ale kenhv'ihsti kesv utalitahstv aninenulahstihsko khanohetv, nahskinho nakhthathvhskvnakwo kehso'i.

nahskihskini' na ohsv katoh tsawhihse'i; nahski tsathvkihsko khanohetv ale tsikolhko'i, ale nahskwo tsakthathvhsko'i, ale tsikananukowhihsko'i, ikatv ahskohitskwi unhehkwotsvhi, ikatvnho hsutalahskohihv ikatvnho tso'ahskohi.
nvwatale tulhilohstanelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki; kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo ahskaya ohstv ukhtha ulokehsv tsuwhihse'i.
ahsenho yvwi unilhinvtsv, uhskaya uluhtse' uyo' ukhtha uwhihse utsalehsti awhihsv uhsuyvne'i; ale i'uwenvhse.
nhahkwonho ulhiyenhv ale ukhthathanv nahskwo uyo unanukotse'i.
nhahkwonho ahskaya kanela tsunvhsitahsti kvwaluhtsele'i, hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; skinvhsitahsti, tlahsko ohstv ukhtha yitsawhihse tsalokehsv'i? kato tikalhstohtaha uyo tsuyhehka?
hian hnituwehsele'i; khilo akhskaki nahski nutvnelv. tsunvhsitahsti hi'a nikvwahsele'i; tsatulihskon okiyhehihsvhstiyi?
ahseno hia nuwehse'ihv vlha, itsiyehihskvyhenho uyo, yitetsinhahahstetlvhta nahskwo utsalehsti.

unelaki ikulaha witathvhi khvnhi' akhthvnatsvha; nhahkwonho akhthvnatsv hi'a nvtakatsiwehseli anihskutehski a ikvyi itsilhihsa uyo, ale titsohthvtsa tikohvhstohti, utsalehstihskini itsilhihsa akihskwankohttiy.
nvwatale tulhilohstanelvkihi hia nuwesvki v kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo atsilv ukhtha, ahskaya tsukihse ale tsuwhihse ulokehsv'i.

nahski utohiyuhsv tsiwotakonatti uhstikhiyu kesvh nika'v ukhtha'a ahsenho athvhi tsiwotakonatti uthvniyu kehsv nika'v uyenhahai, ale tluhkv tsinikalhstiha, nahskinho tsihskwa tsaniluhko'i, tuwanikalhv tsanahatihsko'i.
nvwatale tulhilohstanelvki, hia nuwohsvki a kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo akotohti, nahski akeyhv tsukihse ale tsuhsuyvne tso'i iyulhilotv ihsv kalhv'i, khvnhi nikatv ukohsonhv.
nahski hi'a nikatiyu tsihsa tuwonhthanvki unitsathi tulhilohstanelvki, nitalhilohstanehvnanho kesv vlha yituwonhthane'i.
utohiyutiyi ayelvhsvki atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'i a tatsihstu'ihsi tsi'oli tekatlilohstihskv'i v tatsineihsthani utelitv ahskwanikotv elohi tsutolhvnhv nvtakvwatalenvtv.
nhahkwono tsihsa tuyelihsthanv unitsathi, atanelv wuyvlhvki; kvwhstawatitohinho kvwaluhtshelvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki; tihskiyohsihsasi talhilohsthv uyo tsulhiyenhe tlokehshi.
unhetsvnho hi'a nituwehselvki i nahski na ohstv ukhtha tsuwhihse'i nahski yvwi uwetsi;
tlokehsinho nahski' elanikhv'i; ohstv ukhtha nahski kalvlti' ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv anehi; uyonho tsulhiyhne nahski' unekutsitv tsuwetsi;
akaskinho nahski tsuwhihse'i, nahski ahskina; ukhthvna'ihstiyinh kesv nahski alhskwatvha elohi; anihskutehskihno nahski tinikhanhahwatitohi.
nahskinho uyo tsanilhihsihsko ale tsanakohvhstihsko' atsilvyi, nahskiyahskini nahskwo nuhstehsti alhskwatvha hi'a elohi.
yvwi uwetsi totakanvhsi tsutseli tinikhanhahwatitohi, ale nahski utselikohi totvnotsalehsi nikatv tinatatotehstihski ale nikatv anihskanvki,
tikolhvhsvnho atsilvyi witotvna'ta'ehsi; nanhhtnyvkshti ahle tanltkskst taninutokviti da-ni-nu-do-gv-i.
nhahkwonho unatanhthi kvwanithalukihski kehsehsti unitota utselikohi a nvto nahskiyahi'i khilo tekalilkehsti uthvkotiyhi wathvkvka.

ale nahskwo kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv nahskiyakwo tsukvwalhti' utelitv tlokehsi tsaho'i, nahski iyu ahskaya awahthv, tsatelhvhsko'i v alihelikvnho iyuhsthi tseki tsiwikanateko nikatv uhskwanhikotv'iav ale tsiwuwhahsko' nahski tlokehsi.
ale hnskwo kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv nahskiyakwo kanohtihski tsituyhohe tsuwotuhi takvna-iyunahsti.
nahskinho nhahkwo uwhahthvhv sakwo utsathi tsukvwalhti takvna iyuhsti uwenvhse wunatinvhse nikatv uhskwanikotv'i, nahskino' uwhahse'i.
ale nahskwo kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo akayaluti tsiwunatainvhse amekwohi, ale tsituniniyvhe nani'v tsunatalenhvtv;
nahskinho nhahkwo ukhalitsv amayulhti uninhsinole'i, ale unanvne'i, anohstvnho tithelito tunilvthane'i, uniyonho tunata'invse'i.
nahskihskini nuhstehsti elohi alhskwatvha; tinikhanhahwatitohi tvni'luhtsi, totvnakalenthani uninekutsitv ale unatanhthi;
uninekutsitvnho witotvnata'ehsi tikolhvhsv atsilvyi, nanhahataniyvhkehst al tanltkskst da-ni-lv-da-gi-s-ge-s-di da-ni-nu-do-gv-i.
tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki; itsolhkitsu nikatv hi'a? vv, tsakvwiyuhi, vkvwohselvki.

nhahkwono hi'a' ntuwehselvki; nahski iyuhsti khilo tikowhelihski kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv ukvwalhi' akeyhonvhi tsikehso'i, nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela tsitotikananukohwihsko' tsukvwalhti uhskwanikhtv tsutalenhvtv titse ale tsuwethi.
hi'anho nulhsthanvki, nhahkwo tsihsa uhskwatv hi'a nahski talhilohstihskv'i, unhikihsvki.

nhahakwno uwahsv utselikohi uluhtsv tsunilawi'istiyi tuweyhonhvki; nahski iyuhsti unihskwanikohsvki, ale hi'a nuniwehsvki; kato ulhstohthanv hi'a nahski ahskaya tsakhtha nhaha ale uhskwanikhti tsitulvwhihstaneha?
hi'akhani tinehskehski uwetsi, melikhani' utsi, alekhani' analhinvtli tsimi v ale tsohsi ale hsawani ale tsutahsi?
alekhahni tsuto nikatv ehskanhi tsaneha? katonho ulhstohthanv hi'a nikatv tsuweha?
vkvwakhonelohihselvkinho; ahsenho tsihsa hi'a nituwehselvki; atolehohski vlha natsilvkwotvna yikehso'i, uwahsvhskininonv utselikohi ale uwahsv kanelvhi.
vlhanho yutsathe uhskwanikt nnhhytlhwistanhli, nanohiyuhvhskena' kehsv ntkalhsttskvk. nv-da-ga-li-s-do-di-s-gv-gi.
nahneyu elotv nvhki ikatuki kehsv hstatuki atsikathitihst uthvkane tekanotsalhv tsihsa.
hi'anho nituwehsele tsunvhsitahsti; hi'a nahski tsani titawehski; to'ulenhv tsuyohuhsvki, ale nahski iyuhsti uhskwanikhtiyu tsitulvwhihstaneha.
elotvyhenho uni'yvhe tsani' ale ulhvle'i ale uhstunhe titahstutiyi, kwiliki elotv tinatanhvlhi utali'i elotihsi tsutoitv uhstvtihske'i.
tsaniynho hi'a nuwehsele elotv; vlha tuyukhthv yiki nahski tsatayheha.
ale utulihske uhihstiyi, ahsenho tahska'ihe yvwi, atolehohskihyenho uniyelvse tsani.
ahseno nhahkwo elotv utenhv iyu' ika tunlawitsv a elotihsi uwetsi athv unalihski'elei, ale ohse uyelvnhe elotv.
nahski iyuhsti uhselithane' uthu'ihstanele unhehtiyi nuhstvkwo uthayolv'i.
nhahkwonho utsi uweyhonhvhi nikehse'i hi'a nuwehse'i; anhi hskhiyohelvha tsani titawohski uhskho athelito kalhtehsti.
ukvwiyuhinho uyo'iyu uyelvnhe'i, ahsenho uhselithanv'i, ale nahskwo nhski analhstayvhvhski nvtsulhstohthanei, unhetse atsinehtiyi.
utanvhsenho wunihskutehse tsani titahstutihyi.
uhskonho uniyholhe athelitokihi v ale uninhele athv e nahskino utsi wunhele'i.
kvhwstawatitohinho uniluhtse' ale uninehse ayeli, ale uninihsanhe'i, ale unenvhse wuninhonhele tsihsa.
tsihsanho uthvkanv, tsiyu utsothanvki nanhahunhkiski thyelil inake wlosvki. nhahakwohno yvwi ntvknv, ehlati kwstwatek tehkatuhv totayunnhsvk. do-da-yu-ne-nv-sv-gi.
tsihsanho utsa'ihsv tukohvki unitsathi yvwi, ale tuwetolitsvki v ale tunvwanv

uhsvnho nulhsthanv kvhwstawatohi kvwaluhtselvki hi'a nuniwehsvki v anhi inakekwo i ale ika ulohsonhiti, tsitsenakwon kiyosi hi'a unitsathi yvwi v ale totikatuhv wi'anilohi, nanhhuns unahlstayt uniwsvha. u-ni-wa-sv-ha.
ahsenho tsihsa hi'a ntuwehselvki; vlha ahse' vunenvhsti yiki, nihikwo titselhsta.
hanho nvkvwawehselvki; anhi hihskikwo katu tokiha, thalikwonho atsa'ti.
hi'anho nuwehsvki; anhi tihskiyohihsi.

tunetselvnho unitsathi khanehskohi kehsv unanvtiyi v tukihsvno hihski katu ale thali atsa'ti tunehsv, kahlvlatinho witukhanhanv ulihelitsvki, ale tukvhaluhyv tunhelvk katu kvhwstawtitohi, nahskino kvhwstawatitohi unitsathi wituninhelvki.
nikatvnho unalhstayvnhvki ale tunolhvhsvki v ale unuthihsvki ulikvhaluyhvhi uthiyvhi thalatu iyakhali'i thalutsa.
unalhstayvnhvhino hihskiha iyakayvli anihskaya nani'vki, nitanelhtvna anikeyhv ale tiniyolhi.
khilakwono iyvtv tsisa tunvwhihsthanvki kvhwstawatitohi tsiyuhi unatsotiyihv ale ikvyi nitunihsohihstiyi ahsi tayelihihstihskv unitsathi.
nhahkwonho tuyhelihihsthanv unitsathi otalv unhahluhsvki uwahsv kehsv'i, utatolihsthanvhsvkiai uhsvnho nulhsthanv na-hna u-wa-sv-quo ge-sv-gi.
tsiyunho nhahkwo ayelhi vtali waninihsvki ulhatihsthanitohv ama talhstilhanekv'i, unoleyhenho ikvyitlv tayukhthvki.
nhahkwonho nvhkine' iyuntanetliyvtv kesv aniyahwiski svhnoyi tsihsa wituluhtselvki vtali katu'i aihsvki.
kvhwstawatitohinho kvwakohv vtali katuk; a'ihsv'i unatanhthehthanvki v hia nuniwehsvki; nayehi hi'a. anihska'ihvnho iyuhsti unalhihsthanvki.
ahsenho khilakwo iyvtv tsihsa tunhetselvki, hi'a nituwehselvki v ukalhstikwo itsatanhtata, ayvkwohyenho, lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti.
kwitano unhetsv ha nuwehselvki; tsakvwiyuhi, iyunho nihi kesehstihi skinetsi wikvluhtsehtiyi amayi katu'i.
ehena, utvnhvki. nhahkwono kwita tsiyuhi utsa'ihs amayi katu'i a'isvki tsihsa tsetohv wakhthvki.
ahsenho nvtolehohsv' ahstayiyu kanolv'vhskv uhskalvki, ale ulenvhv kanoyvkv uwelhunhvki, tsakvwiyuhi hskihstelv, utvnhvki.
khilakwonho iyvt tsihsa wutoyhanvhitv wuniyvhvki, hia nuwehselvki; uhsti tsohiyuhi, ka'tohi vtsatlathsithvhsi?
tsiyuhinho i'unatsanv hkanolv'vhskv uhsulkotsvki.
nhahkwono tsiyuhi unatsa'i uniluhtsv kvwatatolihstanelvki v hi'a nuniwehsvki' v utohiyuhiya nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi.
nhahkwonho tunihsohtsv kenihsilati uniluhtsvki.
nanhhanho anehi anihskaya kvwolhtsv, kvwathuwitv tunatanvhsitolvki, tekvwahthinhohelvki nikatv tsunitlvki.
kvwhthayohselvkino kataluyathvkwo nahskwo unhuwv unhsvnhtiyi, nikatvhnho unahsvnhilvhi tunatiwhsvki.
nhahkwonho tsihsa kvwaluhtselvki tinowhelihski ale anikwalihsi tsiluhsilim anehi, hi'a nuniwehsvki;
katonho ketsstawatitohi aniyohstihsko ethi aneh uninhohelhvhi v tlayhenho yitanohsulehsko' tsunoyeni tsvtinalihstayvnhihso'i.
ahseno unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki; katonho nahskwo nihi ethi anehi uninhohelhi itstihsko i'tsiyohstihsko unelhanvhi unhetsvhi?
unelanvhiyenho unhetse hi'a nuwehse'i; hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsi; ale nahskwo hi'a; khihlo tahskinvtihskehsti utota ale utsi ahse uyohuhihsti kehsehsti.
ahsenho nihi hi'a nitsiwehsko'i; iyunho khilo hi'a nikawehsehehsti utota, ale utsi, akwalihskolhthanvhi yeli ketsalhstelhtohti kesv'i nitsatvnehv'i
nikalvkwtihskvnanho ikehsehsti utota, ale utsi, ahvlha uhskanvtsvhi yikehsehsti,] itsatihsko'i. nahski hi'a ethi anehi uninhohelhvhi itsvhthanv ahsekwo nitsvnelv unelhanvhi unhetsvhi.
itsatlonahsti, yelikwo ihsaya tsutolehohse tsitsitvke'i, hi'a tsinuwehshe'i;
hi'a yvwi na'v kvkiluhtseha anihol anhtihhatv ale tunihaneka'lv tanhti kvkilvkwtiha, ahsenho uninawi invhiyu nunvnhv.
ahsekwohskini nanatvneha kvkwatatolihstaneha v tsitanateyhohvhska tanateyohvhskv yvwikwo uninhetsvhi.
wituyhahvnho unitsathi hi'a nituwehselvkihi itsathvkvka ale itsolhki.
vlhahskini nahski na aholi wuyvlhi kataha yinuwaneho yvwi, aholhskini nvtayunukotsvhi nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
nhahkwonho kvhwstawatitohi unilutsv hi'a nikvwahselvki; hikhthahahsko anikwalihsi uninhahlvtsvhi unathvkanv nahski hi'a nitsawehsv'i.
ahsenho unhetsvki hi'a nuwehsvkivv nika'v tuyhehkv etota tsuwhihsvhi nikehsvna tiyhehihsti kehsehsti.
unanelaki, tnkwkw tinikhewi' tinathinhitohi; iyunho tikewi yahthinhi tikhewi itsula athalehsv tsunilv'ihsti.
kwitanho unhetsv ha nuwehselvki; tihskiyohsihsasi hi'a nahski talhilohstv'i.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehselvki v ahsihsko nahskwo nihi nitsolhkvnakwo iki?
tlahsko ahsi yitsolhka nahski nika'v kohuhsti vholi uyvhsthanvhi kehsv ohskwolhiyi wikaluhkv'i, nahskino wikalohihstihskv'kwo?
nahskini' vholi nvtayunukotsvhi onawiyi' titalehvhsko'i'v nahskino kataha nuwaneho yvwi.

onawhyihyenho titalehvhsko uhsonv atanhthehti kehsv'i v ale atahihstiyi kehsv'iav ale atayhonehtiyi kehsv'i v ale utelitv tinhsihtiyi kehsv'i, ale kanohskihstiyi kehsv'i, ale atsikhohtiyi tanatayhi'litohv'i, ale hsotlvhihstohtiyi kehsv'i.
nahskihskini hi'a kataha iyuwanehi yvwi; hnitahsulehvnahskini alhstayvhtiyi' vlha kataha yinuwaneho yvwi.
tsihsanho nanhhunks thayoi ale' satnyi wulosvki. wu-lo-sv-gi.
kvnhiyukwonho kenani ehi akeyv nanhahna ntylsvh uweluhnvhki, hia nuhweselvki; hsktoliki, htskvwiyuhi tewi uwets, kwetsi akeyv utsthnvhi uteyathotiha ahshkihna. a-s-gi-na.
ahsenho nunhetshelvnakwo vkehsvki. kvwahstawa'titohino kvwaluhtselvki, kvwahthayohselvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki; wi'ena, ikihskonhihahyenho.
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehsvki v vlha khilo titsiwahthvtiyhi yvkhinetshelv, awhi uninotena unalenalvhi unvhsv ihsili hsitanelvhi kvhsv'i.
nhahkwonho akeyhv uluhtsv utatolihstanelvki ha nuwehsvki; tsakvwiyuhi, skihstelv.
unhetsvno hia nuwehsvki v vlha yituyukhti tiki'ehtiyi tiniyolhi natseli katu, kilhinho witatinetiyi.
akeyhvnho hia nuwehsvkihsv utohiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhiav ahsenho kilhi analhstayvhtihsko unvko'ohsvhi tikvwaninalha'i tunihskilv'i.
nhahkwono tsihsa unhetsv ha nuwehselvki i hikeyhv utsathi tsohiyuha'v nuhstv tsatulihskv winitsalhstahsi v nahiyukwonho uwetsi utiwhse'i.
tsihsanho nanhhunks kelihli talulti uluhtski, unhhlusvno usahilv u-sa-hi-lv na-hna u-we-nv-gi.

unitsathino yvwi kvwaluhtshelvki v tanahthinehv tiniyo'ulhi, ale tinikhewiai ale tsunvkhewi, ale kohuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi, ale unitsathi nvwanatle'i v ale tsihsa tulahskv na'v tuninvnvki, tunhvwanvkinho.

nahski iyuhsti unitsathi kehsv unihskwanikohsvki, tunikohv tsunvkhewi aniwonihsko'i, ale ahuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi uninhohstv nunalhsthanv'i, alenatitiyo'ulhi, kvwanetahsti nulhsthanv'i ale tinikhewi kvwanikowhahthvhti nulhsthanv'i; unilvkwthanvkinho unelhanvhi ishili unatselika.

tsihsanho wituyanvhv kvwhstawtitohi, hi'a nuwesvki; katsiyatolika hi'a unitsathi kehsv'i, tsoiyhenho natotakwa anhi ketohv anetoha, ale' vlha yiniyheha unalhstayvhti. ale' ilha yakwatuliha tounenvhstiyi tikvwniyohsihski v wanayeno yitaniwanikalok wanahsvhi.
kvwahstawatitohinho hi'a nvkvwawehselvki v hatlvnho yotsiki nahski ika'i alhstayvhti inake'i, nahski iynitsathi yeli tsunolhvhihsti?
tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki v ilako katu tetsiyheha? kalhihkwoki, ilvhskinho tsunhsti atsa'ti, unatvnhvki.
unitsathinho tunhetselvki katohi unanvtiyi.
kalhkwokinho katu tukihsvki ale tunehsv atsa'ti, ulihelitsvno, tukvhaluyhvki, ale kvwhstawatitohi witunhelvki, kvwahstawatitohinho unitsathi wituninhelvki.
ale nkatv unalhstayvnhvki, ale tunolhvhsvki. ale unuthehsvki ulikvhaluyhvhi kalhkwoki iyakhali'i thalutsa.
unalhstayvhinho nvhkiha iyakayvli nani'vki anihskaya, nitanhelhtvna anikeyhv' ale tiniyolhi.
ale unitsathi tuyhelihihsthanvki, ale tsiyuhi wutsanvki v ale makiteli' wunanukotsvki.
anikwalihsinho ale anihsatuhsi uniluhtsvki, kvwakoliyehskvnho kvwhthayohselvki tsuna'nukowhsehtiyi uyeltv kalvlati nvtayulohsvhi.
unhetsv'nho hi'a nituwehselvki; usv ni'hka'lista hi'a nihtsiwehskoi; ulkahlihystv kesestino kalvloyeno kikkiy

sunalenho tsikehso'i, khohi ika tsiki tvkanhahni v kalv'loyhenho kikke'iyu iki, ale ikalokiliyeha, itsatihsko'i. itsatlonahsti, yelikwo itsatolehohsko nuhstv kalvlohi, lhahskonho yeli ketsatolehohihsti yiki uyelhtv iyu lhsthanitahsti kesv'i?
uniyo ale uninekutsitv tsaneha uniyhoho uyelhtv'i, ahsenho vlha' yvkakekalihskolvtasi uyelhv'tvi, tsona atolehohski utseli' uyelhtv uwahsv. tutanv'elvnho unhikihsvki.
kvhwstawatitohino tunihsohtsv unvkhewhihsvhi kehsvki unatenhtiyi.
tsihsanho hia ntuwehselvki i itseyhahthahehsti akothohti anikwalihsi al anhihsatuhsi unatselika.
uninhohelhvkhino kesv unvhsv, hi'a nuniwehsvki; nikatenhvna tsiki nvtikalhstohtiha.
tsihsano nahski utolehohsv hi'a nituwehselvkin' uhsti itsohiyuhi i katonho' itsvhsv kehshv itsinhoheha alhstayvhti' nitsiyhehvna kehsv'i?
tlahsko' ahsi yitsolhka, ale lhahsko yitsanhtha hihski katu ale hihski iyakayvli tsinani'vki, ale' iyakhali'i thalutsa itsuthehsv'i?
ale kalhkwoki katu nvkn iyakayvli tsinani'vki, ale iyakhali'i thalatsa itsuthesv'i?
kato tikalhstohti nitsolhkvna tsiki, nahski hi'a tsinitsvwehsi tlahskini katu yitsitvka, itseyhahthahehsti akothohti anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi unatselika, tsitsvyohsi?
nhahkwonho unolhtsvkih nuninhetshehvna kesv uneyhahtho'ihstiyi katu akothohti, tanateyhohvhskvhskini anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi.
tsihsanho uluhtsv hsihsaliyi kwelikiyi, tuthvtvnhvki kvhwstawtitohi, hia hni'tuwehselvki; ayv yvwi uwetsi tsiki kako kvkwohseho yvwi?
hi'ano nuniwehsvki'; ikatv tsani titawohski [ketsohseho'i,] ikatvnho ilaya, anihsohno tselimaya ale khilo iyuhsti anatole'hohski' kehsv'i.
hianho ntuwehselvki; nihinano kako skiyohseha?
sawaninho kwita unetsv hia nuwehsvki; kalonetv nihi, kvnhitv unelhanvhi uwetsi.
tsihsanho unhetsv ha nuwehselvki; ohsiyu itsalhstanehti nihi sawani tsona uwetsi; vlhayhenho ukwetalhi ale kikv nahski yitsananukowhihselv i etotahskini kalvlati' ehi.
ayvnho hi'a nikvwehsheha; kwita nihi' ale nahski ani hi'a nvyohi takanehskehi akwatseli tsunanelhti unatalhkv'i, ale tsvhskino'i tahstuhvi ehska iyunvnhti nikehsvna kehsehsti.

ale tihstu'ihsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv tsutseli totakvtelihv nika'vnho kohuhsti halhvihehsti elohi, kahlhvhsti kehsehsti kalvlati, nika'vnho kohuhsti halhvkihskehsti elohi kalhvkihsti kehsehsti kalvlati.
nhahkwonho tunvhstatelvki kvhwstawtitohi khilo uninhonhehtiyitinashki wahsv kalonetv kehsv'i.

nhahkwono tsihsa ulenvhvki tunonhelvki kvwhstawatitohi ahse uwenvhstiyi kehsv tsiluhsilimi, ale tsutalenhvtv tsukilhiyotshehtiyi tinilawiki ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilvanelhohi ale tinowhelihski; ale atsi'ihstiyi, ale tsohine ika tsulehtiyi.
nhahkwono kwita iyvtv wuthinhvhsthanv ulenvhvki utanvhstatelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki, unelhanvhi wunvhstohi, tsakvwiyuhi, vlha nahski yinvketsalhstahsi.
ukhthahvhsvnho hi'a natsiwehselv kwita; akwahsohatv halehvka, setani, tihskwotehstihskikwo nihi, vlhayhenho yhatanhtheha unelanhi utselika, yvwikwohskini unatseli hatanhtheha.
nhahkwonho tsihsa ha nituwehselvk kvwhstawtitohi v iyunho khilo utulihskehsti akhstuwatvhstiyi a atatayhihehsti uwahsv, ale tsutanhahwatv ayihskehsti, ale akhstawatekehsti.
khilohyenho utulihskehsti uhstelhtiyi kvnhv'i, uyohuhsehti kehsehsti v khilonho uyohuhsehehsti kvnhi, ayv nvtikalhstohtihskehstiai uwhahthvti kehsehsti.
kato yvwi yunhehkwotsi iyunho elanikhv utseli yinulhsthanv, utanhtonho yuyohuhselv; ale kato yahvka yvwi ykanetliyvhsta utanhto.
yvwiyhenho uwetsi takaluhtsi utota utseli kalvkwtiyu kehsv' unhuwohstehstiav ale tinikhanhahwatitohi tathinhehehsti; nhahkwonho totvkuyv'eli nani'v yvwi' nuhstv tunilvwhihstanelv'i.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehsehahe khilo anhi tanitoka vlha yvtvnatolehohsi ayohuhihsti kehsv'i i khvnhi anikohvha yvwi uwetsi nanhahaukvwiyuhi kes knnktslha. ga-na-nu-go-tsi-lv-ha.
nahiyu tsihsa kvwaluhtselv kvwhstawtitohi, hi'a nikvwawhselvki v kako ulhia tsilvkwotiyu nanhahkalvlati h ukwyhi u-gv-wi-yu-hi ge-sv-i.
tsihsanho ayolhi wuyhanvhv ayelhi aninv uwekhanhvki, ale hi'a nuwesvki;
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; iyunho nitsatanetliyvhsvna ikehsehsti v ale tiniyolhi tsinunhsti nitsalhsthanvna ikehsehsti a vlha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv yvketsiyvha.
nahski iyuhsti khilo' utatolihsti kehsehsti nahskiya ha ayolhi, nahski utli' atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti nanhahkalvlat eh ukwyhi kesvhi. ge-sv-i.
ale khilo tatanilvkehsti hsakwo nahski hi'a iyuhsti ayolhi takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, ayv takwatanilvkehsti.
khilohskini tekotehstihskehsti hsakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv nahski kvkwohiyuhvhski v utli' ohsiyu ahstohski nvya yatsiyalhanv, ale ahsthvhkv amekwohi yatsikvyhv.

uni'iyu iyuhlstanhehti kehsehsti elohi nvtikalhstohtiha tinatatotehstihskiav ahseyhenho tinatatotehstihski uninanuko'ihsti; ahsenho uyo'iyu iyulhstanehti nahski na ahskaya titatotehstihski unanukohwihsvhi.

nahski iyuhsti iyunho tsoyeni ale tsalahsihteni tetsotehstihskehsti, hihskwalhskehsti' ale witsatekehsti; utli ohsiyu itsalhstanehti tsoyeni ale tsalahsihteni tsayohuhselvhi yiki kvnhitv tikehsv wiyitsayvlhv i ano' itsula yithiyehsata ale itsula' titsalahsihteni wiyetsata'inv nikhtlohskvna kehsv atsilvyi.

iyu ale hikhtholi tetsotehstihskehsti v hatakhtheto'ihskehsti ale witsatekehsti; utli ohsiyu itsalhstanehti hsakwo hyikhanhahknt tikesv wyitsyvlhv, ano itsla yithkhnhhtsvskni athsilvyi wytsahtinvno a-tsi-lv-yi wi-ye-tsa-da-i-nv.
itseyhahthahehsti tsikayetsihsotlvhthani sakwo hi'a tsunhstika i hiayhenho nitsvwehseha v kalvlati tssv tsuntselika tinikhanhhawhatitohi nikohilv anikowahthihsko' ukhathv etota kalvlati ehi.
yvwiyhenho uwetsi uluhtsv uhstelvhilhv' ulenalhvhi.
kato itselihaav iyunho khilo ahskaya ahskohitskwi awhi yitunalha'a, hsakwono' yuleyo'elv, tlahsko sonhelhskohi hsonhelakali iyanitv yitikhteko'i, ale yitikhanaluhsitoho katuhsi yuyhoho uleyo'elvhi?
iyunho awahthv i utohiyuhya' itsvyohseha, utli nika'o aliheliko nahski kesv iyuhsti, ehskakwo soonhelahskohi sonhelakali iyanitv nunaleyo'vna.
nahskiya nahskwo' vlha yutuli itsitota kalvlati' ehiai sakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv tsuniyohuhstiyi.
iyunho tihstatanhvlhi itsahskanvtsehehsti, hekehsti hinonhehehsti uhskanvtsv ihstvhsvkwo kehsv'i; iyunho itsathvtahstanehehstiai hiwahthvhehsti tihstatanhvlhi.
iyuhskinino nitsathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti, ahsiyvwi ale anitha'li tehahthinhekehsti v nahskinho aninohehskv anithali ale anitso'i anikhthahi nikatv tshanetsv ahstayohskehsti.

iyunho nahski nitathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti tsunanelhti unatalhkv hinohvhskehsti; iyuhskinino tsunanelhti unatalhkv nitathvtahstanehvna ikehsehsti, nvwatalekwo yvwi ale ayelhikwo-atelv akihsitohi nahskiya hiyatanvthehskehsti.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha'i nika'v kohuhsti itsalhv'ihehsti elohi, kalhvhsti kehsehsti kalvlati i nika'vn kohuhsti itsalhvkihskehsti elohi kalhvkihsti kehsehsti kalvlati.
alewo ha nitsvwehsehha'i iyunho anithali nihi tsitsetoha analikohvhskehsti anhi' elohi nika'vkwo kohuhsti anithayohihehsti v nahski iyunatvnheti kehsehsti etota kalvlati' ehi.
ilvhtlvyhenho anithali ale antsi tstanilawi'o ayv takwato'v tsinvtikalhstohtihsko'i, nanhhayl akwtsuyi. a-qua-da-su-yo-i.
nhahkwonho kwita uluhtselv hia nuwesvkiav tsakvwiyuhi, hilako nakhskanvtsehehsti tsostatanhvlhiai ahsikwo itsiyatolikehsti? kalhkwokihsko'?
tsihsa hi'a nuwehselvki; vlha kalhkwokikwo yikvyoseha, kalhkwahskohihskini kalhkwoki iyulohsvhi.
nahski iyuhsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuh kesv nahskiyakwo khilo ukvwiyuhi tsutanhthelhe ohstv' iyunvnhtiyi tuthukv tsunvhsitahsti.
nhahkwonho unalenvhv ohstv nunvnelv v sakwo akathinohele ahskohi iyukwatinvtv atelv uthuki.
ahsenho kohuhsti uhtaytohti nuhvna kesv iyuhsti, unalha'i unhetse atsinatinvtiyi ale utali'i ale tsuwetsi ale nika'v kohuhsti uhv'i, atayvhtiyinho.
nahski iyuhsti atsinvhsitahsti elati utanvne'i, ale utatolihstanele'i, hia nuwese'i; hskinalha'i, skitoliki skikhthitahi nikatvnho takvyakuyveli.
nahskinho atsinvhsitahsti unalha'i uwetolitse'i, ale u'wekhanhe'i i ale uthukv unelaki uwelihsele'i.

ahsenho nahski na atsinvhsitahsti unukotsvhi uwhahthvhe ahsiyvwi ihtsulaha ketsinvhsitahsti naski unhetsvhi ukuyv'etiyi ahskohitskwi akihsi tsunakvwalhti v uniyvhenho, ale uyhvhskiyvhe'i i skwakuyvhsi tsikvthuka v utvnhe'i.
itsulahano ketsinvhsitahsti tulahskv' elati utanvne utatolihstanele'i, hia nuwese'i; hskitoliki skikhthita v nikatvnho takvyakuyv'eli.
ahsenho vlha yuwohiyunhe'i, titahstutiyikwo wulohshe'i, ale nanhahawhuyhthan ukyty atsihtukv' ikohitv. i-go-hi-dv.
nakwonho nahski itsulaha ketsinvhsitasti unatolehohsv nulhsthanv'i utsathi uyo unyelvnhe'ivv ale uniluhtse uninhonele' tsuninalha'i nikatv nulhsthanitolv'i.
nhahkwonho unalha'i wuyanvhv hi'a nuwehsele'i i tsanekutsitv kvnvhsitahsti i unelaki kvyelihselvki nikatv nihi tsikvthukvki, skithayohselv iyuhsti.
lhahsko nahskwo nihi kahiyatolihsti yikehse itsulaha ehstinvsitahsti v nahskiya kvyatolitsv'i?
uthalhawuhsenho unalha'i, ale wituyohihsele' tinatahstuhvhski ukuyvhohvhstiyi hnikatv' atsithukv ikohitv.
nahskiya nahskwo nttsvyneli etota kalvlati' ehi a iyunho titsatanhthv iyvtv itsihsiyvwiha kehsv nititsitolikvna ikesehst itsatanhvlhi unihskanvtsv'i.
nhahkwonho tsiluhsilmi na'v uniluhtsv, svkhthohi, oliwa uhsahilhi iyvtv, tsihsa anitha'li kvwahstawatitohi tunvhsvki,
hi'a nitwehselvki'; ihstena itlv na tsvtikatuha, khilakwono' iyvt tayehstiwahthvhi hsokwili-tikalianvhitv kelihsatehstihv ale akina athinehehsti, tehstelihsatehsvha, ale teskinathinohelvha.
iyunho khilo kohuhsti ihstohselvha, hi'a nehstiwehselvha; ukvwiyuhi tutuliha; khilakwonho iyvtv totayuyohsi.
nahski hi'a nikatv nulhsthanvkihv utohiyuhti'yi ayelvhsv'i atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'i;
hi'a netsiwehsi hsayani uwetsi akeyhv; khvnhiyukwo ukvwiyuhi tsatseli taya'i, tatsa'luhtsheli utatolihstiyu v ale ukhilvtehsti hsokwili-tikalianvhitv kohuhsti athvnhehi uwetsi akina.
kvwhstawatitohinho unenvhsvkivv tsihsa nuniwehselv nahskiya winunatvnelvki;
sokwili-tikalianvhitv ale akina tunahthinolhvki i tinihsohiyinho tsunanhuwo tunilhvnvki, ale nanha hunakhilvthanvki.
utlinho iyanii' yvwi tsunanhuwo tuniyehstvnvki nvnohi, ikatvnho tunhvnikalvhvki tsuweyhohtha tetluhkvi, ale nvnohi tuniyohthanvnvki.
unitsathino ikvyi aneki, ale' onhi aneki unelhuhkvki, hi'a naniwehskvki v hohsana tewi uwetsi! atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti' yihowa te'uto'v tsika'luhihstiha v hosana' wahsthv kalvlatiyu!
tsiluhsilminho ulutsv nikhv katuhv unalhthelvnhvki, hi'a naniwehskvki; kako hi'a?
unitsathinho hi'a nuniwehsvki; hi'a tsihsa atolehohskiav nahselithi ehi kelili katuhv'i.

tsihsanho wuyvlhvki uthvna-tikalawi'ihstiyi unelanvhi utselika, ale tunukowhihsvki nikatv aninateki ale uniwhahski nanhahtikalawihstiyi, al tulukwtnsk tunihskihlv ahtelv tninetlyski, ale kule tnskonhi tinihnatehki unanvtiyi. u-na-nv-di-yi.
hiano ntuwehselvki; hi'a nikvnv kowela; kwahtseli kalihtsohte tatlhstotiyi kalihtste tuhteshti; ahseno hiha aninohskiski uniystiyi
tinikhewhino ale tiniyo'ulhi kvwaluhtselvki tikalawi'ihstiyi v ale tunhvwanvki.

nhahkwonho nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tinowhelihski unatolehohsv uhskwanikhtiyu tulvwhihstanehv'i v ale tiniyolhi unelhkv uthvna-tiklawi'ihsti'yi hia naniwehskv'iav hohsana tewi uwetsi! utsathi unihsonvtselvki;

ale hi'a nikvwawehselvki; hathvkihsko hi'a tsinaniweha v tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki; vv, lhahsko hilvhiyu hi'a yitsikoliye'o'i v tsunahsti tiniyolhi ale tinihsta'i aniholi unukotsvhi tsawathvhtohthanv etsalvkwtotiyi?
tutanvelvkinho, ale katuhv unukotsvki v kwetiniyi wuluhtsvki, ale nanhhuslk. u-sv-lv-gi.
sunalenho tikatuhv' wv'akhthv'i akonu uyohsihsanhvki.

ukohvnhoh svkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv nvnohulhti, nanhahwltsk; ahseno vhtla khsti ywahtvhi, ulahsthuhsv' uhwahsv; hiahno nwhselvki; tlehsti ilhvhyu kohi ytlnvhtv yitstathansti. kilakwohno yhtv svkatha'-iysti tlukhv uwahyvsvhki. u-wa-yv-sv-gi.
kvwhstawatitohinho unikohv unihskwanikohsvki a hi'a nuniwesvki v nalhekvkwo khvyvhi svkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv'i!

tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki; utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwesehavi iyunho yitsohiyuha, ale nitsatlahtsithv'ehvna yiki, vlha hiakwoh svkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv tsinakvka yinvketsathvka v nahskwohskini hi'a yinitsiwehselv hi'a tsotalv, hatanvna, ale amekwohi wetsatuka, ahse nahski iyulhstohti.
nika'vnho kohuhsti itsithayohihehsti, itsatatolihstihskv'i i itsohiyuhvhskehsti, itsiwathihskehsti.

uthvnanho tikalawi'ihstiyikwuluhtsv v nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tsunathvhsonhvhi yvwi anehv kvwaluhtselvki tateyhohvhskv'i, hia nuniwehsvki; kato tsalhskahstohti hi'a nahski tsitetsalvwhihstaneha? ale kako tshanetshelvhi?
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki v ayv nahskih sutaleki tatsvyathvtvnhi, iyunho nahski ihskinonhelv nahski ayv tatsvnonheli iyuhsti akwalhskahstohtv'i, hi'a nahski tsitakilvwhihstaneha.

tsani tsitatawohskvki hatlv tsutalenhe'i v kalvlatihsko v yvwikwokhe anehv tsutalenhe'i? elhaweyinho unatanvhthelhvki, hi'a naniwehskvki'i iyuno kalvlati, yokatvnhv, katonho tla yetsohiyunhe'i? yokohsi.
iyuno yvwikwo anehv tsutalenhi yokatvnhv, totsihskaihakwo yvwi; nikatvyhenho atolehohski uniyelvha tsani.
uninetsvnho' hi'a nvkvwawhselv tsihsa; vtla yotsikhthaha v hi'ano nituwehselvki; vlha nahskwo' ayv yvketsvnohvhsi' iyuhsti akwalhskahstohtv'i hi'a nahski tsitakilvwhihstaneha.
ahsenho kato itseliha'i khilo ahskaya anithali tsuwetsi anihskaya anehe'i v ahsiyvwihno' ikvyi' wuluhtselv, hi'a nuwehsele'ioi akwetsi i hena khohi wititsalvwhihstahsi thelvlti takwhihsv'i.
tsunhetsvno, vlha, utvnhe'i; ahsenho onhi unetliyvhse utanhthv'i, ale uwenvhse'i.
sohno wuluhtshelv nahskiya nuwehsele'i. tsunetsvnho, takehsi, utvnhe'i; ahsenho nuwenvhsvnakwo ikese'i.

kako hi'a anithali utota unhetsv nutvnele'i i ikvyi wuluhtselvhi, vkvwohselvki v tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki v utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehsehayv atelv anikihsitohi ale tsunatshehsathi anikeyhv unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv waniyvhiha teketsikoniha.

tsaniyhenho tuyukthv' tulvwhihstanehv itsiluhtselvki, ale' vlha yetso'iyunhe'i, atelvhskini anihksitohi ale anikeyhv tsunatshehsathi tsikvwohiyunhvkiai nihinho itsatolehohsv vlha onhi yititsinetliyvhse tetsatanhthv etso'iyuhtiy.

nvwatale talhilohstv itsathvkvka; ehe khilo ahskaya kanela, nahski thelvlatih tuwhihse'i, ale uhsoyhole kvwathuwhitv i ale uhskohse kikake-atithahsti kolhvhthiyihv ale unehskehe inv ikathi, ale tutholhsthane tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi v invnho wulohse'i.
nhahkwono nahniyu kese unvnhstiyi tunvhse tsunvhsitahsti tlokehsi tsunlvwhihstaneh tinehv'i, tuninehsvhse unatatvnvhi.
tlokehsinho tsunilvwhihstanehi tuninihyvhe tsunhvhsitahsti i ahsiyvwi unilvnhile'i, hso'inho unilhe'i, hso'ino nvya tunvnhsthane'i.
tha'linenho tunvhse nvwanatale tsunvhsitahsti utli' iyani'i; nahskiyakwon nitunvnele'i.
onhiyinho uwetsi unvhse'i, hia' nuwehse'i; ahse tvnilvkwthani akwetsi.
ahsenho tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstaneh unikohv uwetsi hi'a nitunatawehsele'ihi nahski hi'a utseli iyulhstotihv kha etiluka v ale etiwonv utseli iyulhstohti tsiki.
uniniyvhenho, ale uninukowihse thelvlati tawhihsi, ale unilhe'i.
nhahkwonho nahski thelvlati tawhhsv utselika kaluhtsvhaai kato totakvneli na tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi?
hi'ano nvkvwawehselvki v uyo'iyu nitotakvneli totvlhi nahski na uniyo'i v ale nvwanatale tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi totvtholhsthanivi nahski yeli kvwankhyvti nanvnhsihsv'i.

tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki; lhahsko ilvhiyu yitsikoliye'o hi'a' tsinikvnhv tsikowhela? ananhehskehski uniyo'ihselvhi nvya nukvwiyuhsv unhvhsiyv ahti nulhsthanv; nahski hia yihwa nutvnelv, ale' uhskwanikhtiyu tetakhanhihskv'i.
nahski iyuhsti hi'a nitsvwehseha v unelhanvhi utselikohi tayetsikisvli v nvwantalenho taketsinelihv nahski yeli kvwaninanukowhihsti utathanvhi.
khilono ni nvyohi alhvtsvha tayuhsonvnhihi khilonho uhsonvha tayuwetawothani.
nhahkwono nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale anikwalihsi unahthvkanv talhilohstihskv'i, unatolehsvki unvhsv ketsitvkv'i.
uniniyhtiyinho unatanhthelhv, unitsathi yvwi tunihskalvkiyv nahskihyenho atolehohski kvwayelvhsvki.
tsihsano unetsv thaline tulhilohstanelvki v ha nuwehsvki;
kalvlati utselikohi nahskiyakwo khilo ukvwiyuhi tsutvnv'ihsthane tsakatsvhstohtiyi uwetsi awinv,
ale tsitunvhse tsunvhsitahsti tsuniyanvhvhstiyi wiketsiyanvtv tekekatshvhstihskv uniluhihstiyi v ahsenho tiuniylvnhekwo nvtayunenvhstiyi.

thalinenho nvwanatale tsunvhsitahsti tunvhse'ivv hi'a nituwehsele'i a hi'a winititsiwehsi wiketsiyanvtv; kvniyukwo akwatvnv'ihsti alhstayvti, tikwatseli wahka ale tikalitsthanvhi tunilhv, nikatiyunho atvnv'ihsthanonhvhi; tekekatsvhstihskv itsiluhki.
ahsenho nvhlsalhikwo tiuniyelvnhe'i, ale utsathinikwo wunilohse'i, ahsiyvwi tsulokehsv'i, so'inho' unhtohtiyi.
anihsohinho tuniniyvhe' tsunvhsitahsti, ale tikvwanihsotlvhthane'i, ale tunilhe'i.
nhahkwonho ukvwiyuhi uthvkanv uthalhawohse'ivv ale tunvhse tsutseli aniyahwski, ale witunilhe nahski tsunatalhvhi, ale wunakohvhsthane' unituhv'i.
nhahkwonho hi'a nituwehsele tsunvhsitahsti; tikekatsvhstohtiyi atvnv'ihsti, ahsenho wiketsiyanvtv vlha yeli yinanohse uniluhihsyi'i
nahskino' iyuhsti tekanvnhahwatihsv witsilohi, nani'vn tetsiwhahthihskehsti tetsinetsehehsti uniluhihstiyi anhi totkekatsvhsthanihsv'i.
howanho nahski tsunvhsitahsti tekanvnhahwatihsv wunilohse'i, ale unilhihsanhe nani'v tuniwhahthvhv uniyo ale anohstv; nhahkwonho ttikekatsvhsthanihsv yeli nulhsthanilhe' analhstayvhvhski.
nhahkwonho uyvlhv ukvwiyuhi' tukhthanhilv analihstayvhvhski, ukohe nanhhasyw nuhnuwvna kehse' tkektshstskv anuwostikv a-nu-wo-s-di.
hano nuwehsele'i; kinali'i v katonho' anhi vhyvlhika nitsanhuwvna iki tekekatsvhstihskv anhuwohsti? elhaweykwonho kehse'i.

nhahkwonho ukvwiyuhi hi'a ntuwehsele ketsinvhsitahstihv etsalvtsa tsuwoyeni ale tsulahsihteni; ale etsinawitv, ale vtoyititlv tsulhsihkv wetsata'uka. hnanhahataniyvhkehst al tanltkskst taninutokvi. da-ni-nu-do-gv-i.
unitsathiyhenho ketsiyanvtv, ahsenho anikiyolhiyu kekahsuyetv.
nhahkwonho anikwalihsi unenvhsvki wuninhohelhvki iyunatvnhtiyi unihsatvtiyhi kawonihskv'i.

tuninvhsvkinho tsetohv kvwhnstawatitohi ale elotv kvwhstelihski, hi'a nuniwehsvki; thateyhohvhski, otsikhthaha utohiyuhkiya kehsv nihiai ale unelhanvhi utselika tuyukhtv tehateyhohvhskv'i, vlha ale yvwi yithinayehska, vtlayhenho nunahstvkwo yvwi yithilvkwohto'i.
nahski iyuhsti skinohvhsivv kato heliha? tsisa tuyukhti hsihsa akuyv'ehtiyi ayel akhyvhti kehsv'i; tlakhe?
ahsenho tsihsa utolehohsvki uyokwo anatanhthehskv'i, ale hi'a nituwehselvki; katonho' ihskihsatv'vhska, i'tsatlonahsti?
tsikowahtv atelv ayelhi akhyvhtohtivv akihsinho tsukvwalhti kvwayhohelvki.
hi'ano nituwehalvki; kako hi'a takatlilohsti, ale kako' atsinoheha hi'a tsikowhela?
sihsa, unatvnhvki. hi'anho nituwehselvki; sihsa atina etsihvhsi hsihsa utselika, unelanvhino unelhanvhi utselika.
unathvkanvnho unihskwanikohsvki, ale unatanv'elvki.
nahiyu ika anihsatuhsi' tilehihsohti kehsv unatlahtsithv'ehi kvwaluhtselvki, ale kvwahthvtvnhvki,

hi'a nuniwesvki; thateyohvhski, mohsi unhetse hi'a nuwehse'i; iyunho ahskaya ayohuhskehsti tsuwetsi nanehvna kehsehsti, tinatanhvlhi atayhekehsti utayhvtv, nahskino tathvhihstanehehsti tiniyolhi tinatanhvlhi.
nahskinho ayv otsehv anehvki kalhkwoki iyanitv anatanhvlhi; utanhilikenho utehsvnhv uyohuhsvkwo, tsuwetsinho nanehvna kehsv iyuhsti utali'i uwekohtanelv unhvlhi.
nahskiya nahskwo tha'line'ihv ale tso'ine'i, kalhkwokine wikvtihski.
ulhskwalthinho akeyhv nahskwo uyohuhsvki.
nahski iyuhsti nhahkwo tsuniyohuhsvhi tanalehihsanhvha, kako utali kehsehsti nahski kalhkwoki iyanitv kehsv'i?
tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki; itsilitahstiha nitsikhthahvna kesv iyuhsti nuhstv kowhelv'i, ale nulhinikvkv unelhanvhi.
tsuniyohuhsvhihyeno tanalehsanhvha, vlha yitanatehsvhvhsko, vtl ale yitketsiyeko'i; tinikhanhahwatitohihskini kalvlati anehi unelhanvhi tsutseli' nahskiya kehso'i.
tsuniyohuhsvhskininonv unalehihsohti kehsv tsitsine'ihstiha, lhahsko yitsikoliye'o unelhanvhi itsnetselvhi, hi'a tsinikaweha?
ayv unelhanvhi ekwahami utselika, ale unelhanvhi ehsik utslk, ale unelhanvhi tsekakwi utselika. vlha unelhanvhi tsuniyohuhsvhi unatseli yiki, tinvnhotvkwohskini unvhsv.
unitsathinho unathvkanv unihskwanikohsvki nuhstv tateyhohvhskvi.
anikwalihsihskini unathvkanv elhawey tuwanhv anihsatuhsi, nahski tunilawitsvki.
ahsiyvwhinho nanhhutsyk tikhnhhwatvsti tikhosihsishki, utvhtvhnvki usatvshkvi, hi'a' hi-a nu-we-sv-gi;
thateyohvhski, kato uhsti utli' kalvkwtiyu ulhinetsv tikhanhahwatvhsti?
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehselvki; yihowa tsanelhanvhi hikeyuhsehsti nika'v tsanawi hvhtihskehsti, ale nika'v tsatanhto, ale nika'v tsatanhthehtiyhi.
nahski hi'a ikvyiy al utsathi kalvkwti tikhanhahwatvhsti.
thalinenho nahskiyakwo nahskwo; tsvhsv tsinitsatakeyuhsv nikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala.
nahski hi'a thali nulhinetsv tulihstayitihsti nikatiyu tikhanhahwatvhsti ale unatolehohsv'i.
ahsikwo tanilawi'v anikwalihsi, tsihsa tuthvtvnhvki,
hi'a nuwehsvki; kato itseli etsatanvthehskv kalonetv, kako uwetsi? tewi, vkvwohselvki.
hi'a nituwehselvki; katonho tikalhstohtiha, tewi atanhto uweyhohvhskv'i, tsakvwiyuhi, tsikohseha? hi'a tsinikaweha;
yihowa' hi'a nuwehselvki ukvwiyuhi akwatselika; tsikathihsi ititlv tsolhehsti v khvnhi ketsskaki titsalahsihtiyhi kahskilo nikatsiyvnelvha;
iyuyhenho tewi, tskvwiyuhi, yikohseha, kato yikalhstohta uwetsi yiki?
tla nhahakwo yeli' khilo skntsh kvwhanetsehti yikehse'i; tla ale khilo nahiyu iyutalenvtv yeli kakvwathvthti yikehse'i.
nhahkwono tsihsa tuwonhthanvki unitsathi ale kvwhstawatitohi,
hia nuwehsvki; tinowhelihski ale anikwalihsi mohsi uwehskilv ani'na;

nahski hiyuhsti nika'v kohuhsti titsikhanhahwatuka ketsohsehehsti tetsikhanhahwatekehsti ale nahski nitsatvnehehsti; ahsenho nahski nanatvnehv'i lhehsti hyinitsatvnehehsti; aninhekoyheno ahsenho vlha nahski yinanatvneho'i.
tanatalhitlvhskoyheno' tikaketv tilihsvhsti ale uteyahthohti tilhsvhstiyi, nahskino yvwi taninhatlhvhsko'i; ahseno unvhsv vlha sakwo aniyehsatv yvkvnta yitokvnithelvhvka.
nikatiyuhskini tunilvwhstanehv yvwikwo kvwanikowhahthvhtiyi uniyelvhso'i. tiyhahthena nitanvneho tsunakvtanohsti, ale taniyhahthv'vhstihsko' tekataluyatv tsunanhuwo;
ale unilvkwto nukvwiyuhsv' tsunanhtlvtiyi tanalhstayvhvhskv'i, ale nukvwiyuhsv tekahskilv tikalawi'ihstiyi,
ale ketsiyolihstiyi tikahntohtiyi, ale thateyohvhski, thateyhohv'hski, kvwanohsetiyi yvwi.
nihihskini lhehsti thateyhohvhski, yetsohsehehsti; ahsiyvwiyhenho titseyhohvhski, nahski kalonetv; nikatvnho' nihi itsalhinvtlikwo.
ale lhehsti khilo etota etsohselvki anhi' elohi; ahsiyvwikwohyehno itsitota, nahski kalvlati tshvtseha.
ale lhehsti skwathinhitohi yetsohsehehsti nihi, ahsiyvwikwohyenho titsathinhitohi, nahski kalonetv.
khilohskini utli atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti nihi itsehv'i, nahski etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti.
khilonho uwahsvkwo atahsalatihskehsti elati iyakvnti kesehsti; khilonho uwahsvkwo elati natatvnehehsti atsihsalatoti kehsehsti.

nihihskini uyo'iyu itsalhstaneti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti! tetsihstunhehohyenho yvwi kalvlati utselikohi; vlhayhenho itsvsv yitsiyvhiho'i, ale' vlha unnelaki waniyvha yititselihseho waniyvhihi.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti! tetsihsvnhehoyhenho tsunohsulotsvhi taninelv'i, ale itsatlonahstv kohitiyu itsatatolihstihsko'i. nahski iyuhsti utlihiyu' ika'i itsikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti! tetsateyohohyehno amekwohi ale katohi etsiyoho ahsiyvwi nuhsthv itsohiyusv kohiyuhvhski iyetsvnhtiyi, ale nahski netsvka tha'li iyuwakhthi utli tsvhskino'i uwetsi netsvneho ehskakwo itsvhsv.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti, titsikhewi titsatathinhitohi! hi'a itsiwehski; khilo iahselithvhskehsti ikhaneihstihskehsti uthvnv-tikalawihstiyi, ahsekwokwo nahski; khilohskini ikhane'ihstihskehsti atelv talonike utvna-tiklawistiy ahv'i, nahski' ahstayiyu ututala.
itsineku ale titsikhewi! kato uhsti utli kalvkwtiyu, atelvhsko talonike'i, uthvna-tikalawihstiyike nahski kalvkwtiyu tsinikvneha atelv talonike'i?
ale, khilo ikhane'ihstihskehsti atsilv-kelhstiyi, ahsekwokwo nahski; khilohskini ikhaneihstihskehsti ahlskolhthanvhi nanhahahi, nski ahstyiy uhttalayu u-du-da-la.
itsineku ale titsikhewi! kato uhsti utli kalvkwtiyu, alhskohlthanvhihsko, atsilvkhe-kelhstiyi, nahski kalvkwtiyu tsinikvneha ahlskolhthanvhi?
nahski iyuhsti khilo i'ahselithvhskehsti ikhane'ihstihskehsti atsilvkelhstiyi, khane'ihstihskehsti nahski ale nika'v go-hu-s-di na-hna a-hv-i.
ale khilo ikhaneihstihskehsti uthvnv-tiklawi'ihstiyi, khane'ihstihskehsti nahski' ale nanhhknel. ga-ne-la.
ale khilo ikhane'ihstihskehsti kalvlati, khane'ihstihskehsti unelhanvhi uwehtiyi ale nanhhuwl. u-wo-li.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti v ahskohineyhenho itsakuyihsko svlhi ale ehsv ale kamini; tetsinhohiyahskonho utli ulhsketvya kehsv tikhanhahwatvhsti, tuyukhtv kehsv'i, ale atatolihstiyi, ale kohiyhtiyi. nahskihskini hi'a yinitsatvnele'iav aleh so'i nitsinhohiyvnakwo yikese'i.
titsikewi titsatathinhitohi v tohsv itsinhahsolvhstihski kemilinho itsikihski.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti! itsohsulehskoyheno' katuititlv ulihskwiti ale athelitovv ahsenho hawinititlv ukhalitsvhi' kehso ahsekwo ataki'ehti kehsi ale tuyukhthv nikehsvna.
hikwalihsi thikhewi i ikvyi hinvkalv hawinititlv ulihskwiti al athelito, katuititlvnho nahskwo tsutanvkalvtv kehsehsti.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti titsowhelihski al itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti! nahskiyakwoyeno nihi tsunekv itikvnelvhi tatselihstvi, nahski katuititlv utohiyuhi tsuwotuhiyu tsikehso'i, ahsenho awhinititlv tsukhalitsvhi tsikehso tsuniyohuhsvhi tsunikhola ale nika'v kataha kehsv'i
nahskiykwohskini' nahskwo nihi katuititlv' itsatanhthiyu nvwahsto'i yvwi tiketsakhanhtiyi v ahsenho hawinititlv itsikhalitsvhi kehso' itsatlonahstv'i ale uyo'i.
uyo'iyu itsalhstanheti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti! tetsolhvhihsihskoyeno tekanihsahv anatolehohski, ale tetsotu'ihstihsko' tatselihstv unatanhthi;
hi'anho nitsiwehsko'i; iyunho ayv yotsehe nahiyu tso'kitota tsanehe'i, vlha ytokayotsalikonhele kikv tunatsewelv anatolehohski.
nahski iyuhsti itsvhsv khvnikehsv nitsatatvne nahski titsitota kehsv anatolehohski tsunilhvhi.
itsikhalitsakhoka titsitota unalhilo'v'i.
inatv nihi! unihskahsehti inatv tsunetsi nihi! katonho yikalhstohta' yetsatiwhihsi akilhiyo'ihsti tikesv tsvhskino'i?

nahski iyuhsti khvnhiyukwo tetsinvli nanhahtitseh antlhsk ale ankthnhhi ahle' tinowhelihsk; iktn totatsihli alhe ttatstni tatanhhwstvi, ikatvno totatslvnhli titsilawishtiyi, a'le uyo nitottsnl tekatunhahai; de-ga-du-hna-v-i;

nahski itsiluhtsehtiyi nikatv ohstv kikv elohi utsewotsvhi, utanhhthi ekwili ukikv nvtakvwatalenvtv, tsekalaya ukikv kwelikaya uwetsi nvtvhsti, nahski tsetsilv utlatnvtv uthvna-tikalawi'ihstiyi atsilvnho-kelhstiyi.
utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha v hi'a nahski nikatv tayunalhiyiloheli hi'a khohi tsaneha.

tsi'luhsilmi! tsiluhsilimi! anatolehohski thihihi, ale ketsaluhtsehtiyi ketsinvhsvhi nvya tvnhstihski v yanokiyu akwatulihskv katsiyalhihsohtiyi titsetsi v nahskiya tsahthaka tsitekalhihsihsko' tsuwetsi anitv tikhanokeni hawinititlv; ahsenho vlha yitsatulihske'i.
kvniyukwo' itsatseli kalhtsote nvtha netsvnelv.
hiayhenho nitsvwehseha; vlha yvkeskikowahthv khohi iyutalenvtv, khvnhi hi'a nitsiwehsvha; atsilvkwotiyu nahski yhowa te'uto'v tsikaluhihstiha.
tsihsanho unukotsvki tikalawi'ihstiyi utanvhsvki, kvwhstawatitohnho kvwaluhtshelv kvwanonhelvki' nituhstv tatanelv uthvnatikalawi'ihstiyi.
tsihsano hi'a nituwehselvki; tlahsko nikatv hi'a yititsikowahthiha? utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; vlha sakwohunv nvya anhi yitutahsahlhahehsti nahski nikohvhthanvna yikehsehsti.

oliwayonho uhsahilhv uwolhv'i kvwahstawatitohi unvhsv kesv kvwaluhtselvki, hi'a nuniwesvki; skinohvhsi hilako' iyu hi'a nahski nvtakalhsthani; ale kato uhsti uyelhtv kehsehsti tsaluhihstiyi, ale khohi kehsv ulhskwatihstiyi?
tsihsano unhetsv hi'a ntuwehselvkiav itseyahthahehsti lhehsti khilo tsitsilonuhelhi;
unitsathehstiyhen ayv takwato'v ani'luhihstihskehsti, ayv kalonetv, anatihskehsti; ale unitsathahsti tanilonuhehskehsti.

ale itsathvkihskehsti tanhahawa ale aninhohelhitohv tanhahya; itseyahthahehsti lhehsti uwelihihsti yinitsalihstanhelehsti; nahskiyeno nikatiyu ase iyulhstohti v ahsenho ulhskwatihstiyi kesv ahsi kehsehsti.
tsunatalenhvtvyeno yvwi totvnalenhi totvnatatluthani v ale ayelhi tunolhvwhatihsv totvnatatluthani v ale takonulohsitohehsti, ale vyhukihyu nikalhsthanitohehsti, ale katohi talihthelvnhitohehsti.
nahski hi'a nikatv alenihskv kehsv akilhiya kehsv'i.
nhahkwonho nihi witotaketsiyohsi itsikilhiyo'ihstiyiav ale totaketsilhi; ale nikatiyu nunatalehsv yvwi ketsihskakehsti ayv takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti.
nhahkwonho unitsathehsti tunotehihehsti, ale tanatatlutihskehsti ale tanatahskakehsti.
ale unitsathehsti unatlonahsti anatolehohski aninanukokehsti, ale unitsathehsti tanilonuhehskehsti.
ale utsathv ahskanv'ihsti kehsv ehv nahski' iyuhsti unitsathehsti atakeyhti kehsv unehv tvyhvtlatti.
ahsenho nahski na kvlhskwatihski alhinikvnehi nahski atsihstelhti kehsehsti.
hiano nahski ohstv khanohetv kalvlati utselikohi elanikhv unalitsitonnitahsti kehsehsti hunatolehohihstiyi nani'v tsunatalenhvtv yvwi, khilanho nhahkwo tvlhskwatilhi.
nahski iyuhsti nhahkwo itsikohvha uhska'ihstiyu kvnohsatvhi ikvnehiuv nahski tenili atolehohsk tsunhesthane'ihv katokehsti kalvkwtiyu kehsv'i v (khilo akoliyehskehsti kolhkehsti,)
nhahkwo tsutiyi' anini analihsvha totsotalv wanilohsvha.
khilon kahsanali ukhi'lehsti lhehsti yvtiutlo'ahsehsti yukihsolhehsti kohuhsti uhv kanelv'i;
ale khilo tlokehsi wetohi lhehsti yvtiutsvhsehsti tsunhuwo yitunehsolhehsti.
ale uyo'iyu iyunalhstanehti tininelitv ale tsunihsta'i nahiyu kehsv'i.
ale itsatatolihstihskehsti itsithayohihehsti kola ale unatotakwahskv itsalihstiyi nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi.
nahiyuyheno utsathehsti akilhiya, nahski ika'i vlha ilvhiyu yinulhsthano elohi tsutolhvnv nvtakvwatalenvtv khohi iyahsthi, vlha ale ilvhiyu nahski iyulhstohti yikehsehsti.
ale nahiyu ika nitahskwalhanvna yiki, vlha ukwetalhi kayetsihstelhti yikaki v ahsenho kekahsuyetv kehshv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti nahiyu ika tihskwalhoti kehsehsti
nahiyu kehsv iyunho khilo hi'a nitsiwehsehehsti, kvnhiyukwo' anhi kalonetv etohahi ale' anhi; lhehsti tsitsohiyunhi

tvninanukotsihyeno unatlonahsti kalonetv ale unatlonahsti anatolehohski, ale aninanukowhihskehst kalvkwtiyu uyelhtv ale uhskwanikhti; nahski iyuhsti iyunho yeli ikvwalhstohti yiki yitanilonuhvli nahskwo kekahsuyetv.
kvnhiyukwo nitsvnonhelv.
nahski iyuhsti iyunho hi'a niketsiwehselvha; inake etoha; lhehsti nanhhwtslsvk; kvniyukwo utelisv khanvhslv ayaav' tlsti tstshihyni. tsi-tso-hi-yu-ni.
anakalihskihyeno tikhalvkv tsvtikannukoko'i, wutelikvnho iyvtv tsiwitkalvhsattihsko'i, nahskiya nahskwo nuhstehsti yvwi uwetsi kaluhtslvha.
ilvhtlvyenho kohuhsti uliwhotsvhi tsikano'i v nanhhawhl anahtatlsski. a-na-da-tli-si-s-go-i.

ikvwenvtakwo' onhi nahski nahiyu akilhiya kalohsonhvhaav nvto' ika ehi tvlhsihvhsi, ale nvt hsvnoyi' ehi vlha ika yuthihstehstiav ale nokwsi tvninvko'ahsi, ale unitsathi kalvlohi tsanikhala tvnalhthelvnhi.

nhahkwonho kalvlo'i tkananukotsi yvwi uwetsi utseli uyelhtv'i, ale nhahakw nikatv tanilhstalhv elohi totvniyvlsi, ale tvnikohi yvwi uwetsi tsa'ihsehsti ulokilv kalvlo'i, ulinihkitiyu kehs ale utsathi kalvkwtiyu kesv unhuwohstehsti.
nhahkwonho totakanvhsi tsunvhsitahsti v ale ahstayiyu tvnitselhuhihsi, ale totvnilhihsanhi kekahsuyetv nvhki nitotikalohskv unole, kalvlo' iyvtv witulhsthinilhv.
kha, itsatelhohkwa talhilohstv svkhthaiyuhsti tluhkv'i; iyuyheno tuwanikalhv' titake nitekalhstha, ale khila'i tsikalhstuhvhsko'i, itsikthaho koki na'vnhiyu kesv'i.
nahskiyahskini nahskwo nihi, iyunho nhahkwo hi'a nahski tsutalenhvtv itsikohvha, itsikhthahehsti ehskanhiyu kehsvi, kalohihstiyikwo kesv'i.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; hi'a khohi tsaneha vlha yvtvnilohsonhi, khvni nikatv hi'a tsutalenhvtv nikalhsthanvha.
kalvlo' ale elohi totakalohsonhivv ayvhskini akhinetsv'i vlha yvtakalohsonhi.
ahsenho nahiyu ika kehsv ale iyulhilotv khalawatisv vlha khilo yakhthaha, lha nahskwo tinikhanhahwatitohi kalvlati anehi, etotahskini uwahsvhiyu.
nahskiyhenho tsinuhste nahiyu noya tsehe'i, nahskiya nuhstehsti yvwi uwetsi kaluhtsvha.
